ec-366.title: Egyptian Chicken Soup with Mastic and Cardamom (Shurbit Firakh)
ec-366.culturalNotes: Recipe 366, page 158 from Egyptian Cooking and Other Middle Eastern Recipes (Samia Abdennour, AUC Press)

instructions.1: Tie the cardamom and mastic in a muslin bag.
instructions.2: Bring 3 cups of water to the boil with the onions and spice bag.
instructions.3: Lower in the chicken, season and turn down the heat.
instructions.4: When the chicken is tender, lift it out, discard the spice bag and mash the onion into the broth.
instructions.5: Add the rice or vermicelli and cook for 12–15 minutes.
instructions.6: Palestinian version (recipe 367 in the book): just before serving, add 1–2 tablespoons of pine nuts and 1/2 cup of parsley leaves and heat without boiling.

ec-373.title: Turkish Wedding Soup (Düğün Çorbası)
ec-373.culturalNotes: Recipe 373, page 160 from Egyptian Cooking and Other Middle Eastern Recipes (Samia Abdennour, AUC Press)

instructions.1: Cut the lamb into bite-sized cubes, roll them in seasoned flour and fry.
instructions.2: Add the lamb to the broth, bring to the boil and add the carrot, onion and seasoning. Simmer for about an hour.
instructions.3: Lift out the meat, keep back one ladleful of soup to cool, and mash the vegetables into the rest. Return the meat and keep the soup over a very low heat.
instructions.4: Beat the egg yolks with the lemon juice, then beat in the cooled ladleful of soup.
instructions.5: Stir the egg mixture into the soup and heat for 2–3 minutes. Do not let it boil or the eggs will curdle.

ec-374.title: Tunisian Fish and Barley Soup (Chorba bil Hout)
ec-374.culturalNotes: Recipe 374, page 160 from Egyptian Cooking and Other Middle Eastern Recipes (Samia Abdennour, AUC Press)

ec-374-i2.name: Fish Head, Backbone, Tail And Trimmings

ec-374-i8.name: Celery Leaves And Stalks, Coarsely Chopped

instructions.1: Cover the fish head, bones and trimmings with water and bring to the boil, skimming as needed.
instructions.2: Boil the barley in salted water for 30 minutes, drain and keep warm.
instructions.3: Fry the fillets lightly and set them aside. Soften the onions in the same oil, add the tomato paste and stir for 2–3 minutes.
instructions.4: Add this to the fish stock with the garlic, cumin, coriander, paprika, parsley, celery, salt and pepper and boil for 20 minutes.
instructions.5: Let it cool, remove the fish pieces, blend the liquid and strain it through a very fine sieve, ideally lined with muslin.
instructions.6: Return to the pot with the barley and fish fillets, check the seasoning and boil for 7–10 minutes, until the fish is cooked.
instructions.7: Add the lemon juice and serve.

ec-376.title: Gulf Mutton, Chickpea and Vermicelli Soup (Tchorba)
ec-376.culturalNotes: Recipe 376, page 162 from Egyptian Cooking and Other Middle Eastern Recipes (Samia Abdennour, AUC Press)

instructions.1: Soak the chickpeas in water overnight.
instructions.2: Fry the cutlets in ghee, then add everything except the vermicelli, cover with twice their volume of water and cook until tender.
instructions.3: Take out the cutlets, mash the vegetables and return the cutlets to the pot.
instructions.4: When the soup boils, check the seasoning, add the vermicelli and cook for 10 minutes more, until it is tender and has taken on the flavour of the soup.

ec-377.title: Tunisian Hlalem Noodle Soup with Lamb and Vegetables
ec-377.culturalNotes: Recipe 377, page 162 from Egyptian Cooking and Other Middle Eastern Recipes (Samia Abdennour, AUC Press)

instructions.1: Soak the chickpeas and fava beans for a few hours. Drain, then boil with the onion in twice their volume of water for 15 minutes. Set aside with their liquid.
instructions.2: Cut the lamb into bite-sized cubes and fry in olive oil. Add the scallions and garlic and cook for 5 minutes, stirring constantly.
instructions.3: Stir in the tomato paste and cook for 5 minutes, then add the spinach, celery, parsley, artichokes, carrots, paprika, salt and pepper and stir until coated.
instructions.4: Add the chickpeas and beans with their liquid and simmer for 30–45 minutes. Cool and skim off any excess fat.
instructions.5: About an hour before serving, bring back to the boil, adding more salted water if needed, then add the hlalem and sweet peppers. Cover and simmer until the noodles are plump and soft.
instructions.6: Add the peas, check the seasoning and sprinkle with fresh coriander.

ec-380.title: Egyptian Chickpea Soup with Cumin and Lemon (Shurbit Hummus)
ec-380.culturalNotes: Recipe 380, page 164 from Egyptian Cooking and Other Middle Eastern Recipes (Samia Abdennour, AUC Press)

instructions.1: Soak the chickpeas overnight and drain.
instructions.2: Cover with twice their volume of fresh water, add the onions and cook for 20–30 minutes, until tender.
instructions.3: Add the cumin, lemon juice, salt and pepper and boil for 3–5 minutes more.
instructions.4: Serve with croutons of baladi bread.

ec-381.title: Thick Chickpea Soup over Bread (Shurbit Hummus)
ec-381.culturalNotes: Recipe 381, page 164 from Egyptian Cooking and Other Middle Eastern Recipes (Samia Abdennour, AUC Press)

instructions.1: Soak the chickpeas overnight and drain.
instructions.2: Cook them with the onions in twice their volume of fresh water for 20–30 minutes. Keep back one cup of the broth.
instructions.3: Add the garlic, cumin and lemon juice to the chickpeas and blend or mash into a thin paste.
instructions.4: Return to the heat, add the oil, season, and cook for 3–5 minutes.
instructions.5: Cut the bread into 2–3 cm pieces and line the serving dish with them.
instructions.6: Reheat the reserved broth, moisten the bread with it and pour the chickpea soup over.

ec-383.title: Tunisian Lablabi (Garlicky Chickpea Soup over Bread)
ec-383.culturalNotes: Recipe 383, page 165 from Egyptian Cooking and Other Middle Eastern Recipes (Samia Abdennour, AUC Press)

instructions.1: Soak the chickpeas overnight and drain.
instructions.2: Boil them in fresh water with the onion and marrow bone until tender. Shake the marrow into the soup and mash it with the onion. Season.
instructions.3: Fry the garlic and harissa in olive oil, stirring constantly so they do not stick.
instructions.4: Add the chickpeas and broth and cook for 5 minutes. Off the heat, stir in the lemon juice and cumin.
instructions.5: Put bite-sized pieces of bread in a serving bowl, pour the soup over and serve at once.

ec-384.title: Cypriot Brown Lentil Soup with Vinegar (Fakes Xidati)
ec-384.culturalNotes: Recipe 384, page 166 from Egyptian Cooking and Other Middle Eastern Recipes (Samia Abdennour, AUC Press)

instructions.1: Put the lentils, spring onions, garlic, oil and parsley in a large pot with twice their volume of water and boil until tender.
instructions.2: Season and keep at a gentle simmer.
instructions.3: Mix the cornflour with a tablespoon of cold water and stir it into the boiling soup to thicken it.
instructions.4: Just before serving, check the seasoning and stir in the vinegar.

ec-388.title: Creamy Zucchini Soup (Shurbit Kosa)
ec-388.culturalNotes: Recipe 388, page 168 from Egyptian Cooking and Other Middle Eastern Recipes (Samia Abdennour, AUC Press)

instructions.1: Peel the zucchini and chop coarsely.
instructions.2: Boil in the stock for about 5 minutes, until tender.
instructions.3: Mash or blend, then add the milk.
instructions.4: Reheat uncovered with salt over a low heat for 3–5 minutes.

ec-389.title: Turkish Hot Yogurt Soup (Yoğurt Çorbası)
ec-389.culturalNotes: Recipe 389, page 168 from Egyptian Cooking and Other Middle Eastern Recipes (Samia Abdennour, AUC Press)

instructions.1: Soften the onions in the oil.
instructions.2: Bring the broth to the boil, add the onions and simmer for about 10 minutes.
instructions.3: Take off the heat and pour in the yogurt gradually, stirring constantly.
instructions.4: Return to the heat just until it reaches boiling point, then take off, add salt and sprinkle with coriander.

ec-390.title: Persian Yogurt Soup with Fenugreek and Walnuts (Eshkeneh Shirazi)
ec-390.culturalNotes: Recipe 390, page 169 from Egyptian Cooking and Other Middle Eastern Recipes (Samia Abdennour, AUC Press)

instructions.1: Grind the fenugreek to a powder.
instructions.2: Fry the onions until golden, add the flour and cook over a very low heat until well blended.
instructions.3: Add the walnuts and fenugreek with 1/2 cup of hot water and stir until smooth.
instructions.4: Add 2 cups of hot water, season and simmer for 30 minutes.
instructions.5: Beat a ladle of the hot soup into the yogurt, then stir the yogurt into the soup over the heat and take it off before it boils.

ec-398.title: Turkish Spinach with Garlic Yogurt (Ispanak Kavurması)
ec-398.culturalNotes: Recipe 398, page 172 from Egyptian Cooking and Other Middle Eastern Recipes (Samia Abdennour, AUC Press)

instructions.1: Wilt the spinach in a pot over a low heat, then drain in a colander, pressing out all the moisture.
instructions.2: Fry the onions in the olive oil until pale brown.
instructions.3: Add the spinach with salt and pepper and cook for 10 minutes, then move to a serving bowl.
instructions.4: Mix the yogurt with the garlic, stir it into the spinach and serve cold.

ec-399.title: Persian Spinach with Lentils (Shuleh Qalamkar)
ec-399.culturalNotes: Recipe 399, page 172 from Egyptian Cooking and Other Middle Eastern Recipes (Samia Abdennour, AUC Press)

instructions.1: Wilt the spinach in a pot over a low heat and drain it in a colander, pressing out all the moisture.
instructions.2: Boil the lentils until tender, drain and mix them into the spinach.
instructions.3: Melt the butter, add the vegetables, garlic, spices, salt and pepper and cook for 5–7 minutes.

ec-402.title: Tomato and Beef Stew with Cardamom (Yakhnit Tamatim)
ec-402.culturalNotes: Recipe 402, page 173 from Egyptian Cooking and Other Middle Eastern Recipes (Samia Abdennour, AUC Press)

ec-402-i1.name: Ripe Tomatoes, Peeled And Coarsely Chopped

instructions.1: Cut the beef into bite-sized cubes. Tie the cardamom and bay leaf in a muslin bag.
instructions.2: Cook the beef in a little water with the spice bag, onions, salt and pepper for about 15 minutes.
instructions.3: Discard the bag and mash the onions.
instructions.4: Add the tomatoes and mixed spice and simmer for 20–30 minutes.
instructions.5: Garlic version (recipe 403 in the book): cook the tomatoes with 10–12 crushed garlic cloves instead of the bay leaf and cardamom.

ec-404.title: Turkish Green Tomato Gratin (Yeşil Domates Graten)
ec-404.culturalNotes: Recipe 404, page 174 from Egyptian Cooking and Other Middle Eastern Recipes (Samia Abdennour, AUC Press)

instructions.1: Soften the onions in olive oil and spread them over the bottom of an ovenproof dish.
instructions.2: Slice the tomatoes thickly and lay them on the onions.
instructions.3: Mix the stock with the rest of the oil, season and pour over.
instructions.4: Cover with foil and bake in a slow oven until the tomatoes are tender.
instructions.5: Mash the vegetables, check the seasoning, stir in the cheese and brown the top under the grill.

ec-414.title: Cypriot Oven-Baked Vegetables (Briami)
ec-414.culturalNotes: Recipe 414, page 179 from Egyptian Cooking and Other Middle Eastern Recipes (Samia Abdennour, AUC Press)

ec-414-i2.name: Zucchini, Peeled And Sliced Into Rounds

ec-414-i3.name: Green Sweet Peppers, Seeded And Chopped

instructions.1: Fry the onions lightly until golden, add the peppers and cook for 5 minutes.
instructions.2: Grease an ovenproof dish and add all the ingredients.
instructions.3: Cover and bake in a moderate oven until all the vegetables are very tender.

ec-415.title: Levantine Eggplant and Chickpea Stew (Mnazzaleh)
ec-415.culturalNotes: Recipe 415, page 179 from Egyptian Cooking and Other Middle Eastern Recipes (Samia Abdennour, AUC Press)

instructions.1: Soak the chickpeas overnight and drain.
instructions.2: Peel and slice the eggplants, salt them and leave for about an hour. Squeeze out the moisture, pat dry, deep-fry and drain on absorbent paper.
instructions.3: Fry the onions until dark in the same oil, then add the tomatoes, garlic and chickpeas and cook for about 20 minutes, until the chickpeas are tender, adding hot water if needed.
instructions.4: Add the fried eggplant, a tablespoon each of parsley and coriander, the mint and the nutmeg or cinnamon. Season and simmer for 10 minutes more.
instructions.5: Let it cool and serve warm, topped with the rest of the herbs.

ec-424.title: Turkish Yogurt Kebab on Toast (Yoğurtlu Kebap)
ec-424.culturalNotes: Recipe 424, page 184 from Egyptian Cooking and Other Middle Eastern Recipes (Samia Abdennour, AUC Press)

instructions.1: Cut the lamb into bite-sized cubes and marinate them in the onions, lemon juice and salt for at least an hour.
instructions.2: Brush off the marinade and fry the lamb slowly until tender. Keep it warm.
instructions.3: Sauté the tomatoes in the same oil, season and cook until the sauce thickens.
instructions.4: Lay the toast in a serving dish, spread with the warm tomato sauce and top with the lamb.
instructions.5: Stir the paprika, salt and pepper into the yogurt and pour it over the meat.

ec-430.title: Zucchini with Onion and Mint (Kosa bi-l-Na‘na‘)
ec-430.culturalNotes: Recipe 430, page 186 from Egyptian Cooking and Other Middle Eastern Recipes (Samia Abdennour, AUC Press)

instructions.1: Peel the zucchini and slice into rounds about 2 cm thick. Slice the onions very thinly and rub them with salt.
instructions.2: Soften the onions in oil.
instructions.3: Add the zucchini and leave over a very low heat for about 20 minutes, until they have reabsorbed their own juice.
instructions.4: Sprinkle with the mint.

ec-432.title: Zucchini Simmered in Yogurt with Mint (Kosa Matbukha bi-l-Zabadi)
ec-432.culturalNotes: Recipe 432, page 187 from Egyptian Cooking and Other Middle Eastern Recipes (Samia Abdennour, AUC Press)

instructions.1: Peel the zucchini and slice into rounds about 2 cm thick.
instructions.2: Cook them over a very low heat until they give up their juice, then drain.
instructions.3: Stir the egg white into the yogurt (it stops the yogurt curdling) and press it through a sieve over the zucchini.
instructions.4: Season and cook uncovered for 15–20 minutes.
instructions.5: Sprinkle with mint and serve hot or cold.

ec-437.title: Turkish Grilled Zucchini Boats with Feta and Dill (Peynirli Kabak)
ec-437.culturalNotes: Recipe 437, page 189 from Egyptian Cooking and Other Middle Eastern Recipes (Samia Abdennour, AUC Press)

ec-437-i8.name: Salt And Freshly Ground Black Pepper

instructions.1: Parboil the zucchini in salted water, drain and let cool.
instructions.2: Halve them lengthwise and scoop out the pulp.
instructions.3: Mix the cheeses, flour, dill and garlic and fill the zucchini.
instructions.4: Top each with a dot of butter, grill until golden and sprinkle with black pepper.

ec-438.title: Turkish Batter-Fried Zucchini (Kabak Kızartması)
ec-438.culturalNotes: Recipe 438, page 189 from Egyptian Cooking and Other Middle Eastern Recipes (Samia Abdennour, AUC Press)

instructions.1: Peel and slice the zucchini.
instructions.2: Beat the flour, salt and sparkling water into a smooth batter.
instructions.3: Dip each slice in the batter and shallow-fry in very hot oil until golden.

ec-446.title: Lemon Granita (Granittat al-Lamun)
ec-446.culturalNotes: Recipe 446, page 193 from Egyptian Cooking and Other Middle Eastern Recipes (Samia Abdennour, AUC Press)

instructions.1: Dissolve the sugar in the water, add the lemon rind and bring to the boil over a low heat.
instructions.2: Boil for 10 minutes, stirring now and then and skimming as needed.
instructions.3: Strain and let cool.
instructions.4: Stir in the lemon juice.
instructions.5: Pour into an ice tray and freeze for 60–90 minutes.

ec-447.title: Orange Granita (Granittat al-Burtu’an)
ec-447.culturalNotes: Recipe 447, page 193 from Egyptian Cooking and Other Middle Eastern Recipes (Samia Abdennour, AUC Press)

ec-447-i5.name: Grated Rind Of Lemons And Oranges

instructions.1: Dissolve the sugar in the water, add the grated rinds and boil gently for 10 minutes, skimming as needed.
instructions.2: Strain and let cool.
instructions.3: Stir in the orange and lemon juice.
instructions.4: Pour into an ice tray and freeze for 60–90 minutes.

ec-448.title: Rosewater Starch Pudding (Baluza)
ec-448.culturalNotes: Recipe 448, page 193 from Egyptian Cooking and Other Middle Eastern Recipes (Samia Abdennour, AUC Press)

ec-448-i5.name: Finely Crushed Roasted Nuts Mixed With Sugar

instructions.1: Mix the starch into 1 cup of cold water.
instructions.2: Dissolve the sugar in the remaining water in a medium pot over a low heat.
instructions.3: Add the starch and stir constantly until the baluza thickens like a thin custard.
instructions.4: Turn off the heat, stir in the rosewater and pour into individual bowls.
instructions.5: When cool, sprinkle with the nuts.

ec-453.title: Baked Pumpkin with Raisins and Milk Cream (Saniyit ’Ar‘ ‘Asali)
ec-453.culturalNotes: Recipe 453, page 195 from Egyptian Cooking and Other Middle Eastern Recipes (Samia Abdennour, AUC Press)

instructions.1: Slice the pumpkin into rounds, remove the seeds, peel and chop roughly.
instructions.2: Stew the pumpkin in its own juice over a very low heat, tossing at first and then stirring gently now and then so it does not stick.
instructions.3: When it is very soft, tilt the pot and pour off as much juice as possible. Add the 1/4 kg sugar and keep over a very low heat until dissolved.
instructions.4: Sweet white sauce: mix the cornflour into half the cold milk, bring the rest of the milk to the boil with the teaspoon of sugar, add the cornflour mixture and cook, stirring, until like a thin custard. Stir in the rosewater.
instructions.5: Mash the pumpkin smooth, spread it in a baking pan and scatter over the raisins and almonds.
instructions.6: Cover with a thin layer of the white sauce; the pumpkin should be twice as thick as the sauce. Pour a beaten egg over the top if you like.
instructions.7: Bake in the middle of a preheated oven until bubbling, then brown the top under the grill.

ec-460.title: Nut-Filled Gullash Fingers in Syrup (Asabi‘ Gullash)
ec-460.culturalNotes: Recipe 460, page 198 from Egyptian Cooking and Other Middle Eastern Recipes (Samia Abdennour, AUC Press)

ec-460-i3.name: Finely Crushed Roasted Nuts Mixed With Sugar

instructions.1: Syrup: boil the sugar and water for 3–5 minutes, add the lemon juice and cook until slightly thickened. Let it cool completely.
instructions.2: Mix the nuts with the cinnamon. Cut the gullash into 10 cm squares and keep them under a cloth.
instructions.3: Working one square at a time, lay a pencil-thin line of filling 1 cm from the edges, turn in the sides and roll up very tightly.
instructions.4: Pack the fingers side by side in a greased baking pan.
instructions.5: Brush each with melted butter and bake in a moderate, preheated oven until golden.
instructions.6: Take them out and dip them lightly in the cold syrup.

ec-472.title: Hot Aniseed Drink (Yansun)
ec-472.culturalNotes: Recipe 472, page 203 from Egyptian Cooking and Other Middle Eastern Recipes (Samia Abdennour, AUC Press)

instructions.1: Boil the water with the aniseed for 1–2 minutes, until fragrant.
instructions.2: Strain, sweeten to taste and serve.

ec-473.title: Hot Caraway Drink (Karawya)
ec-473.culturalNotes: Recipe 473, page 204 from Egyptian Cooking and Other Middle Eastern Recipes (Samia Abdennour, AUC Press)

instructions.1: Boil the water with the caraway for 1–2 minutes, until fragrant.
instructions.2: Strain, sweeten to taste and serve.

ec-474.title: Hot Cinnamon Drink with Nuts (’Irfa)
ec-474.culturalNotes: Recipe 474, page 204 from Egyptian Cooking and Other Middle Eastern Recipes (Samia Abdennour, AUC Press)

instructions.1: Boil the water with the cinnamon for 1–2 minutes, until fragrant.
instructions.2: Strain, sweeten to taste and serve with the nuts sprinkled over each cup.

ec-475.title: Egyptian Turkish Coffee (’Ahwa)
ec-475.culturalNotes: Recipe 475, page 204 from Egyptian Cooking and Other Middle Eastern Recipes (Samia Abdennour, AUC Press)

ec-475-i1.name: Water
ec-475-i1.standardAmount: 1 small coffee cup (about 60 ml) per person

instructions.1: Choose the sweetness: sada (no sugar), ‘ar-riha (just a whiff, up to 1/2 teaspoon), mazbut (as much sugar as coffee) or ziyada (twice as much sugar as coffee).
instructions.2: Heat the water in a kanaka (small long-handled coffee pot), then add the coffee and sugar and stir.
instructions.3: Take it off the heat the moment it rises and forms a layer of foam.
instructions.4: Serve at once, pouring with a gentle shake of the hand so all the foam goes into the cup.
instructions.5: For several cups made in one pot, spoon the foam into the cups first so each gets a share, then pour the coffee gently down the side of each cup.
instructions.6: Mehawega (spiced) coffee (recipe 476 in the book): use coffee ground with cardamom, plus a pinch of mastic or powdered dried orange peel.

ec-477.title: Sweet Fenugreek Drink (Hilba)
ec-477.culturalNotes: Recipe 477, page 205 from Egyptian Cooking and Other Middle Eastern Recipes (Samia Abdennour, AUC Press)

instructions.1: Boil the fenugreek in the water for 15–20 minutes, until the seeds are tender.
instructions.2: Sweeten and pour into cups, seeds and all.
instructions.3: Once the drink is finished, eat the seeds, with a little more sugar if you like.

ec-478.title: Hot Mint Drink (Na‘na‘)
ec-478.culturalNotes: Recipe 478, page 205 from Egyptian Cooking and Other Middle Eastern Recipes (Samia Abdennour, AUC Press)

instructions.1: Bring the water to the boil, add the mint and boil for 1 minute only; longer makes it bitter.
instructions.2: Strain, sweeten to taste and serve.

ec-480.title: Turkish Red Pepper Paste (Biber Salçası)
ec-480.culturalNotes: Recipe 480, page 207 from Egyptian Cooking and Other Middle Eastern Recipes (Samia Abdennour, AUC Press)

instructions.1: Blend the peppers, chili, sugar and salt with 2–3 cups of water in a food processor.
instructions.2: Cook in a pot over a medium heat until thick.
instructions.3: Stir in the olive oil and chill overnight before using.

ec-481.title: Tunisian Hrous (Fermented Onion and Chili Paste)
ec-481.culturalNotes: Recipe 481, page 207 from Egyptian Cooking and Other Middle Eastern Recipes (Samia Abdennour, AUC Press)

instructions.1: Put the onions in a bowl with the turmeric and salt and leave for two days, until wet and soft. Squeeze out the moisture.
instructions.2: Remove the chili’s stem and seeds, chop it coarsely, soak in boiling water for 30 minutes, then drain and pat dry.
instructions.3: Blend everything into a smooth, thick paste.
instructions.4: Pack into a jar, cover with a thin layer of olive oil, close and refrigerate.

ec-483.title: Yemeni Zhug (Green Chili and Coriander Paste)
ec-483.culturalNotes: Recipe 483, page 208 from Egyptian Cooking and Other Middle Eastern Recipes (Samia Abdennour, AUC Press)

instructions.1: Pound everything in a mortar, or blend it, until evenly mixed.
instructions.2: Keep in a tightly closed jar.

ec-485.title: Tunisian Tabil Spice Mix
ec-485.culturalNotes: Recipe 485, page 209 from Egyptian Cooking and Other Middle Eastern Recipes (Samia Abdennour, AUC Press)

instructions.1: Crush all the spices together into a powder, in whatever proportions you like.

db105-7.name: powdered sugar or jam and fruit

instructions.1: Add the salt to the flour and mix, then gradually add the water until a firm, stiff dough forms.
instructions.2: Prepare a baking sheet sprinkled with flour, then roll out the dough into a rectangle.
instructions.3: Spread the softened butter over half of the rolled dough, then fold the other half over it and press the edges lightly.
instructions.4: Roll the dough into a semi-circle shape, then press it with a rolling pin to distribute the air inside.
instructions.5: Roll the dough out to a thickness of 0.5 cm.
instructions.6: Repeat the folding and rolling process approximately 6 times, ensuring no butter leaks out of the dough.
instructions.7: Leave the dough in a cool place for 10 minutes.
instructions.8: Roll the dough out on a water-moistened tray, then prick the dough with a fork.
instructions.9: Bake in a hot oven until cooked, then cut into two equal pieces.
instructions.10: Fill between the layers with cream, then cover with the second layer, topping with either powdered sugar or jam with preserved or fresh fruit, and finished with whipped cream rosettes.

instructions.1: Separate the egg whites from the yolks.
instructions.2: Beat the egg whites thoroughly in a mixer after adding 3 teaspoons of water.
instructions.3: Whisk the yolks well in a bowl, then add them to the beaten whites in the mixer along with the sugar, beating well until the sugar dissolves.
instructions.4: Mix the flour, cocoa, and baking powder, then gradually add them to the mixture alternating with the milk until all ingredients are incorporated.
instructions.5: Grease a baking pan with butter and lightly dust with flour, then pour the batter into the pan and bake in a medium-heat oven until done.
instructions.6: Once baked, leave the cake to cool.
instructions.7: Cut the cake in half and fill with a portion of the chocolate cream, sprinkling with crushed hazelnuts if desired.
instructions.8: Place the second half of the cake on top and cover with the remaining cream, then sprinkle the surface with chopped chocolate and coat the sides with crushed hazelnuts.
instructions.9: You can also garnish by adding swirls of whipped cream with candied cherries.

instructions.1: Add the sugar to the warmed milk and mix well until the sugar is completely dissolved.
instructions.2: Cream the butter with the cocoa powder, then add it to the milk mixture and whisk well until the consistency thickens.

db108-8.name: canned or fresh fruit or pineapple

instructions.1: Separate the egg whites from the yolks and beat the whites thoroughly with a mixer after adding 3 teaspoons of water.
instructions.2: Beat the yolks well in a bowl, then add them to the whipped whites in the mixer along with the sugar, beating the mixture well until the sugar dissolves.
instructions.3: Mix the flour with the baking powder and add it gradually to the mixture, alternating with the milk until all ingredients are incorporated.
instructions.4: Grease a cake pan with ghee and lightly dust with flour, then pour the cake batter into it and bake in a medium-heat oven until done.
instructions.5: After removing from the oven, let the cake cool, then flip it onto a serving plate.
instructions.6: Boil 5 cups of water with sugar added as needed, then remove from heat and add the jelly, stirring continuously until completely dissolved.
instructions.7: Pour one-third of the jelly mixture over the cake.
instructions.8: Place the remaining jelly in the refrigerator to set, but do not let it freeze solid.
instructions.9: Slice the banana or pineapple and arrange the slices neatly over the jelly layer.
instructions.10: Pour one-third of the jelly over the fruit, then return to the refrigerator to set, and then to the freezer to firm up.
instructions.11: Carefully place the cake base over the jelly layer, then pour the remaining third of the set jelly over the top, and return to the freezer until frozen.
instructions.12: To serve, move the pan over hot steam for a few seconds, then flip onto a serving plate; you can garnish the surface with whipped cream rosettes.

db109-8.name: chantilly cream or pastry cream for filling

instructions.1: Boil the water and butter together, then remove from heat.
instructions.2: Add the flour and a pinch of salt to the boiling water all at once while stirring constantly.
instructions.3: Place back over low heat and stir continuously for 5 minutes until it forms a ball, then remove and set aside to cool.
instructions.4: Add the eggs and vanilla to the dough one by one, mixing well after each addition.
instructions.5: Prepare a lightly greased baking sheet and pipe small pieces of choux dough about the size of a large hazelnut, leaving space between each one.
instructions.6: Bake in a hot oven until cooked through and the surface is firm.
instructions.7: Let them cool, then they can be sliced open and filled with chantilly cream or pastry cream.
instructions.8: Arrange the profiteroles on a deep serving platter and pour the chocolate sauce over them.

instructions.1: Mix the cornstarch with a little cold water, then combine with the chocolate powder, gradually adding the remaining water while stirring constantly.
instructions.2: Place the mixture over medium heat and whisk continuously until it reaches a boil.
instructions.3: Add the sugar and butter, then simmer while stirring for 5 minutes until the consistency thickens.
instructions.4: Remove from heat and use immediately to coat the profiteroles.
instructions.5: Once the sauce has cooled over the profiteroles, place them in the refrigerator.

des-106.title: Choux Pastry Fritters with Cinnamon Sugar

instructions.1: Boil the water with the butter, stirring them together, then add the vanilla and remove from heat.
instructions.2: Gradually add the flour and a pinch of salt to the boiling water while stirring continuously over the heat until fully dissolved, then remove from heat.
instructions.3: Once the dough has cooled, add the eggs one by one, whisking well into the mixture with a whisk.
instructions.4: Add the raisins and nuts to the dough.
instructions.5: Grease your hands with a little oil, take a small piece of dough, and fry it in hot (but not smoking) oil, then transfer to paper towels.
instructions.6: After frying the entire batch, sprinkle with powdered sugar and cinnamon.

des-107.title: Layered Biscuit Bavarois with Fruit and Cream

db112-7.name: Decorative sauce (caramel, chocolate, orange butter, or jam)

db112-8.name: Cocoa powder, grated chocolate, hazelnuts, walnuts, and crushed nuts for garnish

instructions.1: Prepare a Pyrex dish and break the biscuits into pieces according to the amount of cream.
instructions.2: Pour the hot crème pâtissière over the biscuits and mix together until the biscuits absorb the cream without crumbling completely.
instructions.3: Mix a little jam with a little cream, then add nuts and coconut, and distribute this mixture over the biscuit and cream base.
instructions.4: Sprinkle the top with grated chocolate and let it cool, then place it in the refrigerator.
instructions.5: Once cooled, remove the Pyrex from the refrigerator, pour the Chantilly cream mixture over it, and top with sliced fruit or mixed fruit compote, then return to the refrigerator.
instructions.6: Garnish using caramel sauce, chocolate, orange butter, or jam, spreading it well over the fruit and Chantilly cream.
instructions.7: Sprinkle grated chocolate on top, paired with peeled hazelnuts, walnuts, or crushed nuts according to taste.

instructions.1: Whisk the eggs well, then add the cornstarch or custard powder and mix thoroughly.
instructions.2: Boil the milk with the sugar over medium heat, then remove from the stove.
instructions.3: Add the egg mixture to the milk and stir well, then return to low heat while whisking constantly until it thickens for use, then sprinkle with vanilla.
instructions.4: Mix in the chopped chocolate or cocoa powder until the color turns brown.

db114-3.name: Banana, strawberry, guava, peach, or pineapple

instructions.1: Blend the milk with your choice of fruit (such as banana, strawberry, guava, peach, or pineapple) and sugar in a blender.
instructions.2: Using an electric hand mixer, pour the fruit-milk mixture into a bowl, add the Chantilly cream powder, and whip for approximately 3 minutes.

instructions.1: Place the sugar and a little water in a pan and cook until it turns golden brown like caramel.
instructions.2: Pour the cream or double cream into the caramel, lower the heat, and stir carefully to ensure it melts completely.
instructions.3: Add the grated chocolate to the mixture.

db116-4.name: Unsweetened cocoa powder or chocolate powder

instructions.1: Whisk all ingredients together until well combined.
instructions.2: Place the mixture over low heat, stirring constantly until the consistency becomes smooth and liquid.
instructions.3: You can double the ingredients to ensure enough to cover the entire cake surface.

instructions.1: Beat the butter well, then gradually add the sugar while continuing to whisk. Add the fine orange zest and beat everything together thoroughly.

des-113.title: Whipped Jam or Jelly Meringue Topping

instructions.1: Melt the jelly or jam in a water bath until it reaches a thin consistency.
instructions.2: Whisk the egg whites with a pinch of salt until stiff peaks form.
instructions.3: Add the jelly or jam to the egg whites and whisk well until the consistency is medium, making it easy to spread over the cake surface.

osool-001.title: Dark Broth (Brown Stock)
osool-001.culturalNotes: This broth is the base for the clear soups and brown sauces in the book; the onion is browned to give it its dark color.

instructions.1: Chop the onion and fry it in the ghee until it turns dark, then let the pot cool slightly.
instructions.2: Trim the fat from the meat and cut it into small pieces; scoop the marrow out of the bones and rinse the bones quickly.
instructions.3: Add the meat, bones and cold water over the browned onion and set the pot aside for a while so the meat juices draw out into the water.
instructions.4: Place the pot over very low heat and leave it for about three hours without letting it boil.
instructions.5: Add the chopped vegetables, spices and salt and continue cooking for about two hours.
instructions.6: Strain the broth through a fine sieve and leave it in a cool place until the next day, then remove the layer of solidified fat from the surface.

osool-002-i5.name: Egg whites with their shells (for clarifying)

instructions.1: Mince the meat finely, separate the egg whites carefully, wash the shells well and crush them, and clean the vegetables, leaving them whole.
instructions.2: Put all the ingredients in a wide, spotlessly clean pot.
instructions.3: Set the pot over low heat and whisk the mixture vigorously and continuously until it is close to boiling, then remove the whisk.
instructions.4: Raise the heat and leave the soup undisturbed until the foamy egg-white layer sets and floats to the surface.
instructions.5: Lower the heat completely and leave the pot half covered for about 40 minutes.
instructions.6: Pour the soup through a thick cloth or dry tea towel, pouring the set layer in first so the rest of the liquid filters through it and comes out clear and transparent; strain a second time if needed.
instructions.7: Soup with vegetables: cut two carrots, a piece of celery root and a turnip into small cubes or thin sticks, boil them separately and rinse in cold water, then add them to the soup just before serving so it stays clear.
instructions.8: Winter soup: add a little carrot and turnip cut into small pea-sized balls, rounds of inner cabbage leaves, green peas and small cauliflower florets, at one part vegetables to six parts soup.
instructions.9: With rice or pasta: add 3 tablespoons of boiled, rinsed rice to the winter soup, or boil fine orzo-like pasta in salted water and add it to the soup.
instructions.10: Princess soup: for each liter of soup, add half a boiled chicken breast cut into cubes and 1 tablespoon of boiled, rinsed pearl barley just before serving.
instructions.11: Royal soup: for each egg yolk use 1 teaspoon of cream, milk or broth; mix and season, divide into two parts and tint one pink, steam each part in a greased mold until set, then unmold once cool, cut into decorative shapes and add to the soup.

instructions.1: Trim the fat from the meat and cut it into small pieces; cut the vegetables into small cubes.
instructions.2: Add the water to the meat and cook over low heat for an hour and a half, skimming off the scum whenever it appears. If using barley instead of rice, add it at this stage.
instructions.3: Add the rice and chopped vegetables and continue cooking until tender, about an hour.
instructions.4: Remove the bones and let the soup cool, then lift off the layer of fat from its surface.
instructions.5: Reheat the soup, add the chopped parsley and serve.
instructions.6: Lamb broth: use the same ingredients and method, but lift the meat out of the soup and serve it on its own with a little parsley or browned; serve the soup with bread toasted in the oven or fried and cut into triangles instead of the meat pieces.

osool-004-i4.name: French bread loaf, sliced into small rounds and toasted in the oven

instructions.1: Peel the turnip and carrot and cut them into small rounds; slice the bread into rounds and toast it in the oven.
instructions.2: Sauté the vegetable rounds in the butter.
instructions.3: Add the broth, salt, pepper and nutmeg and simmer over low heat until the vegetables are tender but not falling apart.
instructions.4: Sprinkle with parsley and serve hot with the toasted bread rounds.

instructions.1: Split the head, remove the brain and place it in salted water.
instructions.2: Remove the small bones and any hair, wash the head well with salt, taking care to clean the nose and eye sockets, then soak it in salted water for 10 minutes.
instructions.3: Remove the tongue, prepare it and cook it separately as you like.
instructions.4: Add the water to the head and cook over low heat for a full hour, skimming off the scum whenever it appears; add a whole onion, to be removed later.
instructions.5: Cut the vegetables into even pieces and add them with the rice, salt and spices; simmer the soup over low heat until done (about two hours), then lift out the head.
instructions.6: Add the chopped parsley and serve the soup hot; serve the head on its own, or take the meat off and cut it into small pieces to add to the soup.

instructions.1: Skin the rabbit, wash it well and cut the meat into fairly small pieces.
instructions.2: Add the water to the meat and bring the pot to a boil over low heat, skimming off the scum whenever it appears.
instructions.3: When the meat is nearly done, add the rice, the vegetables cut into small cubes and a little salt, and continue cooking until everything is tender.
instructions.4: Lift out the meat pieces, cut some of them into cubes and add them to the soup, then reheat and serve.
instructions.5: Serve the rest of the meat on its own, boiled, or with white sauce, or browned.

instructions.1: Peel, clean and wash the sprouted fava beans.
instructions.2: Heat the ghee or oil, add the mastic, then add the water and bring it to a boil.
instructions.3: Add the beans, the lemon and the peeled onion and cook over medium heat until tender, skimming off the scum whenever it rises; add the salt shortly before the beans are done.
instructions.4: Add the chopped parsley and boil the soup for five minutes, then season and serve hot.

osool-008-i3.name: Piece of white celery and an onion

osool-008-i8.name: Lemon juice or vinegar (to keep the artichokes)

instructions.1: Clean the artichokes by removing the leaves and the fuzzy choke, then slice them thinly and keep them in water with lemon juice or vinegar until needed.
instructions.2: Clean the vegetables and slice them thinly.
instructions.3: Sauté the artichokes and vegetables in the butter, then cover with the stock or water and cook until everything is tender.
instructions.4: Press the vegetables through a sieve, add most of the milk and bring to a boil.
instructions.5: Mix the flour well with a little milk and add it to the soup, stirring constantly, then return the pot to the heat and bring to a boil while stirring; season with salt and white pepper.
instructions.6: Add the cream at the end, taking care not to heat the soup after that, and serve.
instructions.7: Second method, without flour: ¾ kg artichokes, a piece of celery and an onion, 3 cups white stock, 1 tablespoon ghee and 1 cup milk; sauté the artichokes and vegetables in the ghee for 5 minutes, add the stock and bring to a boil, then lower the heat until the vegetables are tender; press through a sieve, add the milk, return to the heat and season.

instructions.1: Bring the asparagus to a boil in the salted water or stock.
instructions.2: Lift out the tender asparagus tips and set them aside to garnish the soup; leave the rest on the heat until tender, then press through a sieve.
instructions.3: Stir the ghee with the flour over the heat, then add the sieved asparagus, the water or stock it was boiled in, and the milk, and bring to a boil, stirring constantly.
instructions.4: Season the soup, garnish with the asparagus tips and serve.
instructions.5: If using cream instead of milk, add it at the end and do not reheat the soup afterwards.

instructions.1: Wash the celery and slice it thinly; slice the onion the same way.
instructions.2: Sauté the vegetables in the ghee for 5 minutes, then add the stock and leave the pot on the heat until they are tender.
instructions.3: Add the flour mixed with the cold milk and bring to a boil.
instructions.4: Strain the soup and reheat it, then take it off the heat, add the cream if using, and serve with the fried bread.

instructions.1: Shell and wash the peas.
instructions.2: Put the peas, onion, mint and stock in a pot over low heat until completely tender.
instructions.3: Press the vegetables through a sieve, return them to the pot and add the ghee.
instructions.4: Mix the flour or cornflour well with the milk and add it to the soup while stirring, then bring to a full boil, stirring.
instructions.5: Season the soup and add the cream and a little green coloring if desired.

instructions.1: Wash, peel and thinly slice the potatoes; slice the onion the same way.
instructions.2: Sauté the potatoes and onion in the ghee for 5 minutes.
instructions.3: Add the stock or water and simmer over low heat until tender.
instructions.4: Press the soup through a fine-meshed strainer, return it to the heat and add the flour mixed well with the milk.
instructions.5: Cook, stirring, until it comes to a full boil and the flour is cooked, then season and serve hot.

instructions.1: Cut a cross into each chestnut, boil them for a quarter of an hour, then peel.
instructions.2: Sauté them in the butter, then add the stock and cook until tender (30 to 50 minutes).
instructions.3: Press through a hair sieve or fine-meshed strainer.
instructions.4: Mix the flour or cornflour well with the milk; return the sieved chestnuts to the heat and, when boiling, add the mixture while stirring well and let it come back to a boil.
instructions.5: Take the pot off the heat and let the soup cool slightly, then add the cream, season, and serve with the fried bread.

instructions.1: Sauté the pumpkin and onion in the ghee, then add the stock and seasonings and cook until completely tender; press through a sieve.
instructions.2: Return the purée to the heat with most of the milk and bring to a boil, stirring.
instructions.3: Mix the flour well with the rest of the cold milk and add it to the boiling soup, stirring well.
instructions.4: Let the soup boil for 5 minutes, stirring, then season and serve.
instructions.5: Second method: for ½ kg pumpkin, peel and cut into small pieces and sauté with a thinly sliced onion in 1 tablespoon ghee for 20 minutes; add 2 full cups of stock or water until tender, press through a sieve, add 1 tablespoon flour mixed with ½ cup milk and return to the heat for 3 minutes, stirring.

instructions.1: Wash the peas well and soak them in cold water for 12 hours.
instructions.2: Sauté the peas and the chopped vegetables (if using) in the butter for 5 minutes.
instructions.3: Add the stock and leave the pot on the heat until the peas are completely tender, then press the soup through a sieve.
instructions.4: Mix the flour well with the water or milk, add it to the sieved soup and boil for 5 minutes, stirring constantly.
instructions.5: Season, add a little green coloring if desired, and serve.

instructions.1: Wash the meat and cut it into very small pieces; cut the vegetables into cubes.
instructions.2: Put the meat, vegetables, stock and spices in a pot over low heat until the meat and vegetables are tender, then strain to separate them from the liquid.
instructions.3: Bring the soup liquid to a boil and add the cornflour or flour mixed with a little cold water, stirring well.
instructions.4: Boil again for 5 minutes, then add the reserved vegetables and meat and serve.

instructions.1: Wash the rabbit and cut it into pieces; put it in a pot with the onions, cardamom, celery, mastic and water.
instructions.2: Cook over low heat until the meat is tender, skimming off the scum whenever it appears.
instructions.3: Strain the soup and lift out the meat to serve at the table as desired; let the liquid cool, then remove the layer of fat from its surface.
instructions.4: Bring the liquid to a boil, then add the flour mixed with the cold milk, stirring well, and let it boil for 5 minutes.
instructions.5: Serve the soup with the fried bread cubes.

osool-018-i5.name: Boiled vegetables cut into decorative shapes

instructions.1: Melt the butter or ghee, add the flour and stir over the heat briefly without letting it color.
instructions.2: Add the stock gradually, stirring well, and bring to a boil while stirring constantly; let it boil for 5 minutes.
instructions.3: Mix the egg yolks and cream together, then strain the mixture into the liquid, provided it is not too hot.
instructions.4: Reheat the soup over low heat without boiling until the eggs are cooked.
instructions.5: Season, add a little lemon juice, then add the cut vegetables and serve.

osool-019.title: Soup Thickened with Egg and Cream

osool-019-i5.name: Fried or toasted bread cubes, for serving

instructions.1: Beat the egg yolks and add them to the cream.
instructions.2: Heat the stock until it is almost boiling.
instructions.3: Take the stock off the heat and add the yolk and cream mixture, stirring well.
instructions.4: Return the pot to very low heat, or set it beside the heat, and keep stirring until the soup thickens, making sure it does not boil or it will separate.
instructions.5: Season with salt and pepper and serve with the fried or toasted bread.

osool-020.title: Soup Thickened with Egg and Lemon

instructions.1: Separate the yolks and add a little salt, white pepper and the lemon juice; stir well.
instructions.2: Heat the stock until it boils.
instructions.3: Pour the hot stock over the yolk mixture, stirring well, and serve at once.

osool-021.title: Soup Thickened with Flour and Lemon

instructions.1: Bring the stock to a boil, then take the pot off the heat.
instructions.2: Mix the flour well with a little cold stock and add it to the pot, stirring well.
instructions.3: Return the pot to the heat and boil for 5 minutes.
instructions.4: Season with salt and pepper, add the lemon juice and serve.

instructions.1: Bring the stock to a boil and sprinkle in the tapioca, stirring well.
instructions.2: Keep it on the heat, stirring, for 20 minutes.
instructions.3: Beat the egg yolks with the cream; let the soup cool slightly, then add the mixture.
instructions.4: Reheat the soup without letting it boil, season and serve.

osool-023.title: Egyptian-Style White Fish Soup
osool-023.culturalNotes: Fish soup is light and economical; its broth can be made from any cheap, lean fish, or even from fish bones, skin and heads. It is usually served to the sick and during fasting periods.

instructions.1: Heat the ghee and fry the mastic in it, then add the water, salt, cardamom, onion and celery and bring to a boil.
instructions.2: Add the prepared fish and the lemon juice and leave the pot on the heat until the fish is cooked.
instructions.3: Serve the soup with the fish cut into even pieces and sprinkled with chopped parsley, or serve the fish separately garnished with lemon and parsley and the soup on its own.

instructions.1: Heat the ghee and fry the mastic and cardamom in it, then sauté the fish in it and lift it out.
instructions.2: Add the water to the ghee and bring to a boil.
instructions.3: Dissolve the flour in a little water and add it to the boiling water, stirring well; let it boil for 10 minutes so the flour cooks, then season with salt and pepper.
instructions.4: Add the fish and cook over low heat until nearly done, then add the chopped parsley and celery.
instructions.5: Take the pot off the heat once the fish is fully cooked and add the lemon juice.

instructions.1: Prepare the fish, then poach it with the prepared vegetables; add the salt, pepper and cloves and cook until it is just done.
instructions.2: Lift the fish out of the liquid, remove the skin and bones, and cut the flesh into small, even pieces.
instructions.3: Return the bones and skin to the liquid and boil for no more than half an hour, then strain the liquid.
instructions.4: Mix the flour well with the milk and add it to the strained broth; boil for five minutes, then add the cut fish and boil again for 3 to 5 minutes.
instructions.5: Add the lemon juice and chopped parsley and serve hot.

osool-026.title: Dark Fish Soup (Coastal Style)
osool-026.culturalNotes: This soup is popular in the coastal cities; it gets its dark color from frying the onion in oil.

instructions.1: Slice the onion thinly and fry it in the oil until it is well darkened.
instructions.2: Pour the water over it, add the salt and pepper and bring to a boil.
instructions.3: Add the fish and cook until done.
instructions.4: Lift out the fish and serve it on its own, or remove its skin and bones and cut it into suitable pieces to add to the strained soup.

osool-901.title: Boiled Eggs, Served Several Ways (Fried and with Mayonnaise)
osool-901.culturalNotes: Keep the heat neither high nor fast, so the white does not set too quickly and stop the heat reaching the yolk.

instructions.1: Soft-boiled eggs: drop the eggs into boiling water and boil for 3½ to 4 minutes depending on size; or drop them into boiling water and cover the pot off the heat for 5 to 10 minutes; or put them in cold water, bring to a boil over low heat, then leave for one minute.
instructions.2: Hard-boiled eggs: put the eggs in cold water, bring to a boil over low heat and cook for 15 minutes after boiling, then leave in cold water until ready to peel.
instructions.3: Fried boiled eggs (mera'lel): heat the ghee until very hot and fry the peeled hard-boiled eggs in it; lift out, sprinkle with salt and pepper, arrange on a plate and garnish with parsley; tomato sauce may be served alongside.
instructions.4: Eggs with mayonnaise: leave the cold hard-boiled eggs whole or halve them lengthwise; arrange on a plate, cover with the mayonnaise and garnish with chopped parsley.

osool-902.title: Hard-Boiled Eggs in White Sauce ('Sun Disc')

osool-902-i3.name: Small fried bread triangles (for the second method)

instructions.1: Peel the eggs and cut into rounds or halve lengthwise, keeping back the yolks of two eggs.
instructions.2: Arrange the eggs on a warm plate and cover with the hot white sauce.
instructions.3: Sieve the reserved yolks over the top to form a sun with its rays, and serve hot.
instructions.4: Second method: halve the eggs and separate the yolks from the whites; chop the whites coarsely, add them to the hot sauce and season; put on a warm plate, decorate the top with the yolk halves and chopped parsley, and set the bread triangles around the plate.

instructions.1: Heat the ghee until very hot and fry the onion in it until browned.
instructions.2: Add the strained tomatoes and cook until done, then add the parsley and water, season with salt and pepper and boil for two minutes.
instructions.3: Add the peeled eggs to the tomato sauce and cook over low heat for 5 minutes, turning them halfway through.
instructions.4: Lift the eggs out of the sauce and halve them lengthwise or leave whole.
instructions.5: Arrange the eggs on a plate and pour the tomato sauce over them.
instructions.6: The eggs and tomatoes can be served inside a ring of mashed potatoes.

osool-904-i3.name: For the curry sauce: small onion and ghee

osool-904-i4.name: For the curry sauce: curry powder and flour

osool-904-i6.name: For the curry sauce: chopped apple and lemon juice

instructions.1: Make the curry sauce: fry the onion in the ghee, then add the curry powder, flour and apple, then the stock gradually while stirring; simmer over low heat for half an hour and add the lemon.
instructions.2: Peel the eggs, add them to the sauce and leave for 5 minutes.
instructions.3: Lift the eggs out of the sauce and halve them lengthwise.
instructions.4: Arrange the rice on the plate in a hollow ring.
instructions.5: Place the eggs inside the ring and pour the sauce over them or around the rice.

osool-905.title: Stuffed Eggs (with Anchovy, Cream or Mayonnaise)

osool-905-i7.name: Paprika and a little red food coloring

osool-905-i9.name: Tomato, cucumber or beet rounds, for serving

instructions.1: Peel the eggs and cut each in half crosswise, trimming a small piece off the bottom of each half so it stands steadily.
instructions.2: Remove the yolks and press them through a wire sieve or mash them well.
instructions.3: With anchovy: add the butter, anchovy essence (or wiped, boned and pounded anchovies) and paprika to the yolks; work the mixture until completely smooth and tint it lightly.
instructions.4: Put the mixture in a paper or cloth piping bag with a rosette tip and pipe rosettes into the egg-white halves.
instructions.5: Set each on a round of tomato, cucumber or cooked beet.
instructions.6: With cream: add the whipped cream, parsley and salt to the sieved yolks and pipe rosettes into the whites; serve on a bed of green salad.
instructions.7: Cream eggs (no. 2): halve the eggs lengthwise; mix the sieved yolks with 1½ tablespoons butter, 2 tablespoons whipped cream, salt and pepper; fill the whites with the mixture, then press each two halves together to form a whole egg and decorate the seam with small rosettes of the mixture.
instructions.8: With mayonnaise: made like the cream eggs, replacing the cream with mayonnaise.

instructions.1: Add the vinegar or lemon and the salt to the boiling water.
instructions.2: Carefully break an egg into a cup.
instructions.3: Stir the water in a circle and gently pour in the egg, neatening its edges so it takes a round shape; leave for 2 to 3 minutes.
instructions.4: Lift out carefully with a slotted spoon and drain.
instructions.5: Place on a round of buttered toast and serve hot.
instructions.6: In milk: like poached eggs in water, using milk instead of water and leaving out the vinegar or lemon.
instructions.7: In tomato: like eggs poached in milk, replacing the milk with a light tomato sauce.
instructions.8: With spinach: make ¼ kg spinach purée and spread it on the plate; poach the eggs, place them on top and serve at once, hot.
instructions.9: With rumi cheese: place the poached eggs on buttered toast rounds; melt 1 tablespoon butter and add 1 tablespoon milk, 1 heaped tablespoon grated rumi cheese, ¼ teaspoon mustard, a little paprika and salt; stir over low heat until thick, cover the eggs with it and garnish with parsley.

osool-907.title: Eggs Baked in Shells with Spinach and White Sauce

instructions.1: Brush four scallop shells with warm ghee and put a layer of spinach in each.
instructions.2: Place a poached egg on the spinach layer.
instructions.3: Cover the egg with a layer of white sauce.
instructions.4: Sprinkle the rumi cheese on top and bake in a hot oven until browned, then serve at once.
instructions.5: Hard-boiled eggs in shells: slice 6 hard-boiled eggs into rounds and arrange in greased shells; cover with 1 cup cheese sauce, sprinkle the top with breadcrumbs, dot with small pieces of butter and bake in a hot oven until browned; garnish with parsley.

osool-908-i2.name: Butter or vegetable ghee
osool-908-i2.standardAmount: a walnut-sized piece or 1 level tablespoon per egg

osool-908-i4.name: Square or round pieces of fried bread or buttered toast

instructions.1: Break the eggs, add the milk, salt and pepper and mix everything together.
instructions.2: Melt the butter or ghee, add the mixture and stir quickly over low heat; take the pan off the heat when the mixture has set a little.
instructions.3: Put the scrambled eggs on the prepared bread, garnish with parsley and serve hot.

osool-909.title: Fried Eggs with Pastirma, Sausage or Spiced Mince

osool-909-i2.name: Pastirma or sausage (⅛ kg) or asag (2 tablespoons)

instructions.1: Fry the pastirma in a little ghee and spread it over the pan.
instructions.2: Carefully break the eggs over it one at a time and sprinkle with a little salt and pepper.
instructions.3: Return the pan to the heat for two or three minutes until the whites set.
instructions.4: Serve in the pan itself, wrapped in a paper frill, or lift the eggs out carefully and arrange on a plate.
instructions.5: With sausage: cut the sausage into fairly small pieces and half-fry in very hot ghee; break the eggs over it one at a time, sprinkle with a little salt and pepper and cook until the whites set; serve hot.
instructions.6: With spiced mince: add the ghee to the asag and heat through completely, then break the eggs over it one after another, sprinkle with salt and pepper, and return the pan to the heat or put it in the oven until the whites set.

osool-910.title: Egg Fritters with Garlic and Cumin, or with Vegetables

osool-910-i6.name: Small chopped onion and chopped parsley (for the second method)

osool-910-i7.name: Tomato and boiled potato (for vegetable fritters)

instructions.1: Crush the garlic finely, then add the cumin.
instructions.2: Beat the eggs lightly, then add the garlic and cumin mixture and the breadcrumbs; season with salt and pepper and beat briefly.
instructions.3: Heat the oil in a frying pan until very hot and pour in half the mixture; brown the fritter on both sides and lift it out of the oil.
instructions.4: Repeat to make a second fritter; place on a plate and garnish with parsley.
instructions.5: Egg fritters with onion: rub the onion with salt and pepper and add to the eggs with the parsley; pour a quarter of the mixture into very hot oil until the underside browns, turn it, and repeat.
instructions.6: Egg fritters with vegetables: break 6 eggs and beat lightly; peel a tomato and cut into small pieces, and chop a boiled potato; fry the onion in 1 tablespoon ghee, add the tomato, parsley and potato and fry briefly, then let cool and add to the eggs; heat a little ghee in a frying pan, pour in a coffee-cup measure of the mixture to make a fritter and turn it when the underside browns.

osool-911-i3.name: Flour seasoned with salt and pepper

osool-911-i6.name: Tomato sauce or green salad, for serving

instructions.1: Peel the eggs and dust them lightly with the seasoned flour.
instructions.2: Remove the sausage casings, knead the meat well and divide it into four.
instructions.3: Wrap each egg in a portion of sausage meat, smoothing it evenly and sealing the edges, then coat in egg and then breadcrumbs.
instructions.4: Fry in the ghee, lift out and let cool slightly, then cut in half crosswise.
instructions.5: To serve hot: place each half on a round of fried bread or buttered toast and pour a little tomato sauce around the plate.
instructions.6: Or serve cold: place each half on a round of tomato or cucumber and garnish the plate with a green salad in French dressing or a lettuce salad with mayonnaise.
instructions.7: Scotch eggs (no. 2): mince ⅛ kg meat finely two or three times and season with onion juice, salt, pepper and nutmeg; add ⅛ kg sausage meat, knead well and divide into four; finish as above.

osool-912-i9.name: Tomato sauce or spinach purée, for serving

instructions.1: Peel the eggs and chop them with a knife.
instructions.2: Make the thick sauce and add the chopped eggs and seasoning.
instructions.3: Add the raw eggs and reheat the mixture over low heat.
instructions.4: Spread the mixture on a wetted plate to cool, then divide into six portions and shape each like a cutlet.
instructions.5: Coat the pieces with a light layer of seasoned flour, then with egg and breadcrumbs.
instructions.6: Deep-fry in plenty of ghee, lift out and drain on paper; stick a parsley stem into the pointed end of each to represent the rib bone.
instructions.7: Serve hot with tomato sauce, or on a layer of spinach purée.
instructions.8: Egg croquettes: make the egg cutlet mixture and shape it into balls; coat in seasoned flour, then egg and breadcrumbs, and deep-fry in plenty of ghee; serve with tomato sauce.

osool-913-i5.name: For variations: grated rumi cheese, green pepper, potato, asag, liver and kidneys, onion and tomato, or chopped poultry meat

instructions.1: Break the eggs into a bowl, add the water or milk, salt and pepper and stir with a fork until the yolks and whites are blended.
instructions.2: Put the ghee in a frying pan and heat until it melts and warms slightly, without letting it get very hot.
instructions.3: Pour the mixture into the pan on the heat; when the eggs begin to set, make a few cuts in the top with the tip of a knife so the liquid runs through, and continue until slightly set.
instructions.4: Take the pan off the heat and carefully fold the near edge of the omelette toward the center, then fold the far edge the same way.
instructions.5: Return the pan to the heat until the underside browns, then turn out onto a plate and serve at once.
instructions.6: With rumi cheese: add 2 tablespoons grated rumi cheese with 2 tablespoons cream or milk instead of water; with cheese and tomato, use tomato sauce instead of the cream.
instructions.7: With green pepper, potato or spiced mince: add 2 tablespoons thinly sliced sweet green pepper, or 4 tablespoons small fried potato pieces, or 2 tablespoons asag, for every 4 to 6 eggs.
instructions.8: Filled omelette: before folding, spread the center of the omelette with some asag, or chopped cooked liver and kidneys, or fried onion with a little tomato juice and seasoning, or chopped cooked poultry with a little sauce; then fold, brown the underside and serve.
instructions.9: Rolled French omelette: pour just enough mixture into the greased pan to coat it in a thin layer and cook until set; turn out onto a plate and roll up like a cigarette; repeat until the mixture is used up; they can be filled before rolling with asag, spinach, cheese or liver.

osool-914.title: Puffy English Omelette
osool-914.culturalNotes: Nothing is added to the raw eggs in this method, but the omelette can be filled before folding. In Europe it is sometimes filled with jam and known as a sweet omelette.

instructions.1: Separate the yolks from the whites; add the water, milk or cream, salt and pepper to the yolks and stir with a fork.
instructions.2: Beat the whites with a fork or whisk until completely stiff.
instructions.3: Add the yolks to the whites and fold them together lightly and carefully with a spoon so the whites do not collapse.
instructions.4: Put the ghee in a frying pan and heat until it melts and warms somewhat, without letting it get very hot.
instructions.5: Pour the mixture into the pan and bake in a fairly hot oven for 3 to 5 minutes until the top browns.
instructions.6: Take the pan out of the oven and put it on the heat until the underside browns, then fold in half only.

instructions.1: Heat the ghee until very hot and fry the onion in it, or make asag with minced meat and onion.
instructions.2: Brown the flour lightly, then take the pan off the heat and let it cool somewhat.
instructions.3: Beat the eggs and add the salt, pepper and parsley, along with the onion and flour mixture.
instructions.4: Heat a little ghee in the frying pan until very hot and pour in the mixture.
instructions.5: Brown over low heat, then turn it over to brown the other side, or finish it in the oven.
instructions.6: Place on a warm plate and serve as is, or cut into pieces and garnish with parsley.
instructions.7: Simple Egyptian omelette (no. 1): beat 3 eggs and season with salt and pepper; heat 1 tablespoon ghee in a frying pan until very hot, pour in the eggs and stir lightly with a fork until they begin to set; leave until the top turns yellow, then fold one side over the other; return to the heat until the underside browns, turn out onto a plate and garnish with parsley.

instructions.1: Rub the onion with salt and pepper; peel the tomato and cut into small pieces; chop the pepper.
instructions.2: Beat the eggs lightly and add all the ingredients.
instructions.3: Heat the ghee in a frying pan until very hot and pour in the egg mixture; cook until the underside browns, then turn it over and cook until done, or finish it in the oven.
instructions.4: Turn out onto a plate and serve hot.

osool-917.title: Baked Eggs (with Breadcrumbs and Cheese, or with Tomatoes)

osool-917-i5.name: For the tomato method: a medium chopped onion and ½ cup strained tomatoes

instructions.1: Grease an ovenproof dish or small metal plate with ghee.
instructions.2: Carefully break the eggs one at a time into the greased dish and season with salt and pepper.
instructions.3: Sprinkle the top with parsley, then with breadcrumbs or rumi cheese.
instructions.4: Heat some ghee until very hot and drizzle it over the eggs.
instructions.5: Bake in a moderate oven until the whites set, and serve hot.
instructions.6: Baked eggs with tomatoes: heat 1 tablespoon ghee until very hot and fry the chopped onion until golden, then add the tomatoes and cook until nearly done; put in an ovenproof dish and carefully break 6 eggs over it, keeping the yolks whole; bake in a moderate oven until the whites set and sprinkle with salt and pepper.

osool-918.title: Savory Soufflé (Cheese, Chicken, Fish or Vegetable)
osool-918.culturalNotes: For a successful soufflé: grease the mold well with warm ghee, cook the thick sauce thoroughly, add the yolks one at a time while beating well, and fold in the whisked whites extremely lightly so the air does not escape. For chicken, meat and fish soufflés, line the bottom of the mold with paper greased with ghee so the bottom does not brown.

osool-918-i1.name: For the thick white sauce: butter

osool-918-i2.name: For the thick white sauce: flour

osool-918-i3.name: For the thick white sauce: milk

osool-918-i7.name: Or: cooked chicken, fish or lamb, minced and sieved

osool-918-i8.name: Or: mashed spinach, carrots or peas

instructions.1: Grease the soufflé mold well with warm ghee; if steaming, wrap a folded paper collar around it that rises 3 inches above the rim, tie it with string and grease it with ghee.
instructions.2: Make a thick white sauce with the flour, butter and milk, boil it well and take it off the heat.
instructions.3: Add the cheese (or the sieved minced meat or mashed vegetables) and stir well, then add the egg yolks one at a time, stirring constantly.
instructions.4: Beat the mixture well for 3 minutes and season with salt and pepper.
instructions.5: Whisk the egg whites until completely stiff, then add them to the mixture and fold in extremely lightly so the air does not escape.
instructions.6: Pour the mixture into the prepared mold to halfway, since it rises a great deal.
instructions.7: Bake in a moderate oven for 20 to 30 minutes, or steam slowly until the center sets.
instructions.8: Turn out onto a warm plate and serve at once with a suitable sauce.
instructions.9: Cauliflower soufflé: layer ½ kg boiled, cut-up cauliflower with 3 tablespoons rumi cheese and tomato rounds in the prepared mold; pour the soufflé mixture (white sauce, 3 yolks and their whisked whites) over it, bake in a moderate oven for 30 minutes and serve hot.

osool-401.title: Poached Fresh Fish and Its Sauces
osool-401.culturalNotes: Fish is cooked when the bone comes away easily from the flesh and the skin splits. You can also season the fish with lemon and pepper, wrap it in greased paper and poach it; this keeps its nutrients from leaching into the water.

osool-401-i1.name: Fresh white fish (mullet, bayad, sea bass or lot)

osool-401-i7.name: Sauce for serving (white, parsley, mustard or anchovy)

instructions.1: Clean the fish; if you want to poach it whole, leave the head on and remove the eyes.
instructions.2: Weigh the fish to work out the cooking time: 6 to 10 minutes per ½ kg plus 6 to 10 minutes.
instructions.3: In a pot, prepare just enough water to cover the fish and add the salt, vinegar or lemon, cardamom, mastic and onion.
instructions.4: Put the fish into the poaching water while it is hot but before it boils, and keep it at that temperature, without letting it bubble, until the fish is cooked.
instructions.5: Lift the fish out of the water and drain it well on a clean piece of cheesecloth.
instructions.6: Serve whole on a paper doily or folded napkin, garnished with lemon and parsley, with the sauce served separately.
instructions.7: Or remove the skin and serve covered with a suitable sauce, or remove the bones, arrange in portions, cover with the sauce and garnish with boiled or pickled carrots.

osool-402-i2.name: Egg sauce or white sauce, for serving

osool-402-i3.name: Lemon, parsley and boiled carrots, for garnish

instructions.1: Cut the fish into medium portions, wash it and soak in cold water for 12 to 18 hours, changing the water every 4 hours.
instructions.2: Clean off the scales well and rinse.
instructions.3: Cover with cold water, set over low heat and cook until tender.
instructions.4: Lift out of the water, pat dry, arrange on a suitable plate and cover with the sauce; egg sauce and white sauce are best.

osool-403.title: Spiced Boiled Shrimp
osool-403.culturalNotes: Shrimp differ from fish in that they need no added water; their own liquid is enough to cook them.

osool-403-i7.name: French dressing (vinegar and oil), for serving

instructions.1: Wash the shrimp several times to get rid of the sand.
instructions.2: Arrange in alternating layers with the onion rings and celery, a little salt, pepper, cumin, mastic, cardamom and the lemon juice; add a little water only for large shrimp.
instructions.3: Cover the pot and cook over low heat until done, stirring from time to time.
instructions.4: Take the pot off the heat and shake the contents.
instructions.5: Serve as they are, unpeeled, with French dressing, or peel and serve as you like.

osool-404-i8.name: For the salad: a little paprika

osool-404-i10.name: Lettuce, tomatoes, parsley and lemon, for serving

instructions.1: Put the lobster in a pot with the onion, celery, water, salt, pepper and lemon juice and cook over low heat until done.
instructions.2: For the salad: remove the meat from the lobster while keeping the shell intact, and clean the shell well by wiping it with a clean cloth.
instructions.3: Mix the meat with the oil and vinegar and season with salt and pepper.
instructions.4: Fill the shell with the seasoned mixture, then garnish with lemon, parsley, chopped egg white and sieved egg yolk.
instructions.5: Arrange on a plate lined with a vegetable salad (lettuce and tomatoes).

instructions.1: Fry the chopped onion in the oil until it darkens, then take the pot off the heat and crush the onion well; add the water, salt and pepper and bring to a boil.
instructions.2: Peel the raw shrimp, add them to the water and cook until half done.
instructions.3: Add the washed rice, stir everything briefly and leave the pot over low heat until the rice is cooked.
instructions.4: Serve on plates garnished with thin lemon slices, parsley and whole peeled shrimp, or press lightly into a mold, then turn out and garnish.
instructions.5: Sayadiya with cooked shrimp: made the same way using cooked peeled shrimp, added to the rice shortly before it is done and stirred in to distribute them.

osool-406-i1.name: Poached fish (with celery added to the poaching water)

osool-406-i5.name: For garnish: boiled peeled shrimp, hard-boiled eggs, lettuce, small tomatoes, pickles and olives

instructions.1: Poach the fish as usual, adding some celery to the poaching water.
instructions.2: Lift the fish out of the water and drain it; remove the skin and bones while it is hot, keeping the head and tail intact.
instructions.3: Leave the body of the fish whole, or flake it with a fork (the better method, since it removes the fine bones); season the flesh with salt, pepper, lemon juice and a little of the sauce.
instructions.4: Arrange the flaked fish on an oblong plate in the shape of a fish, add the head and tail and cover with the sauce.
instructions.5: Garnish as you like with pickles, lettuce, tomatoes, shrimp and eggs.
instructions.6: Fish fillet in mayonnaise: shape the fish into one large fillet without the head and tail and cover it with a thick layer of sauce.
instructions.7: Fish in mayonnaise shells: mix the fish with a fairly large amount of the sauce and put it into scallop shells, piled up or flat; cover with a layer of mayonnaise and serve one shell per person.

osool-407.title: Fish Kamikh (Layered Fish Salad with Mayonnaise)

osool-407-i1.name: Boiled fish, cut up, without bones or skin

instructions.1: Arrange the fish and prepared vegetables in alternating layers, with a little sauce between each layer.
instructions.2: Cover the top with sauce and garnish with the boiled egg slices.
instructions.3: Second method: season the boiled fish with salt, pepper and lemon juice and layer it as above with lettuce and arugula, using mayonnaise, English dressing or French dressing; garnish with pickled cucumber, boiled shrimp, pitted black olives and salted boiled beets cut into rounds.

osool-408-i2.name: Taratour sauce (tahini with vinegar and garlic)

osool-408-i6.name: For garnish: very thin pickled cucumbers, pickled carrots, lemon and parsley leaves

instructions.1: Clean and poach the fish and remove the skin and bones, keeping the head and tail intact; or clean the fish and bake it in the oven with a little oil.
instructions.2: Flake the flesh to remove the bones and season with salt, pepper and lemon juice.
instructions.3: Arrange half the seasoned fish on an oblong plate in the shape of a fish, spread a layer of taratour sauce over it, then add the head and tail.
instructions.4: Cover the sauce with the rest of the fish and smooth the top completely so it forms a full fish with an even surface.
instructions.5: Cover the fish with the remaining sauce and garnish with the cucumbers, lemon and carrots.

osool-409.title: Tomatoes Stuffed with Shrimp or Fish

osool-409-i2.name: Boiled, peeled, salted shrimp (or boiled flaked fish)

instructions.1: Hollow out the tomatoes, salt them whole, turn them upside down and leave them to drain.
instructions.2: Fill with the boiled, peeled, salted shrimp and cover the shrimp with mayonnaise.
instructions.3: Wash and dry the lettuce leaves, leave them whole and arrange them side by side around the serving plate to form a bed, with their edges level with the rim of the plate.
instructions.4: Arrange the stuffed tomatoes neatly on the bed, and garnish with a little parsley if you like.
instructions.5: With fish: halve 5 tomatoes, hollow them out, salt and turn upside down; mix ¼ kg boiled flaked fish with 3 tablespoons mayonnaise, a little chopped pickled cucumber, salt and pepper; pile the mixture into the tomatoes, decorate with parsley leaves and add a handle made of parsley stems so they look like baskets.

osool-410-i1.name: Fish (heads, tails and a few steaks are best)

instructions.1: Clean the fish and cut it into steaks.
instructions.2: Heat the ghee or oil until very hot, add the mastic and cardamom, then sauté the fish and lift it out.
instructions.3: Stir the flour in the remaining oil or ghee without letting it brown, then add the water gradually, stirring constantly.
instructions.4: Season the sauce and bring it to a boil, then add the sautéed fish, cover the pot and cook over low heat until the fish is done.
instructions.5: Add the lemon juice, adjust the seasoning, ladle out hot and garnish with lemon and parsley.

instructions.1: Clean, wash and thoroughly dry the fish.
instructions.2: Melt half the ghee and sauté the fish in it without letting it brown.
instructions.3: Add the stock or milk, cover and cook over low heat until done (about a quarter of an hour); lift out the fish and place it on a warm plate, and top up the remaining liquid with milk to make one cup.
instructions.4: Melt the rest of the ghee and stir in the flour, then pour in the liquid gradually, stirring well.
instructions.5: Boil the sauce for 3 minutes, take it off the heat and let it cool slightly, then add the cream and lemon juice, stir well and adjust the seasoning.
instructions.6: Strain it over the fish and garnish with lemon and parsley.

osool-412.title: Fish Poached in Milk
osool-412.culturalNotes: A light, easily digested dish suitable for children and the sick.

instructions.1: Heat the milk, add the fish and cook over low heat until done (half an hour to an hour), keeping the pot covered; then lift it out and arrange on a plate.
instructions.2: Mix the flour with a little milk and add it to the milk the fish was cooked in; stir well and return to the heat to boil for three minutes.
instructions.3: Season, add the parsley and pour the sauce over the fish.

osool-413.title: Baked Fish with Tomatoes and Celery

instructions.1: Slice the onions into thin rings and rub them with salt and pepper.
instructions.2: Add the sliced or finely chopped garlic, the shredded celery, the parsley, the lemon and some of the tomatoes cut into rounds.
instructions.3: Put half the mixture in a baking tray or tagine, then the seasoned fish, then the other half.
instructions.4: Arrange the remaining tomatoes on top, sprinkle the tray with the olive oil and add a little water.
instructions.5: Cover the tray or tagine and bake in a moderate oven until done, then uncover and leave briefly so the top layer of tomatoes browns.

instructions.1: Heat the oil until very hot, add the finely crushed garlic mixed with the cumin and stir well until golden; then add the tomato juice, if using, and cook until done.
instructions.2: Add the water and bring to a boil, then add the prepared fish and cook over low heat with the pot covered until done; ladle out.
instructions.3: Or put it in a tagine, cover and bake in the oven until the fish is cooked, and serve it in the tagine.

osool-415-i2.name: For the curry sauce: small onion

osool-415-i4.name: For the curry sauce: curry powder

osool-415-i7.name: For the curry sauce: chopped apple and lemon juice

instructions.1: Clean the fish, remove the skin and bones and cut into small steaks.
instructions.2: Make the curry sauce: fry the onion in the ghee, then add the curry powder and flour and stir, then the apple; add the stock gradually, stirring until it boils, then leave over low heat and add the lemon.
instructions.3: Add the fish to the sauce, cover the pot and cook over very low heat until the fish is done.
instructions.4: Boil the rice and arrange it around the plate with a hollow in the middle.
instructions.5: Put the curried fish in the hollow and garnish the plate with lemon and parsley.
instructions.6: Lobster or shrimp curry: take the meat from 3 or 4 cooked lobsters, cut it into small pieces, season with salt, pepper and a pinch of mustard, heat it in 1 cup curry sauce and serve with rice around it; shrimp curry is made the same way after boiling and peeling the shrimp.

instructions.1: Fry the onions lightly in the oil, then add the carrots and stir well.
