instructions.2: Add the water to cover the vegetables and cook until nearly tender.
instructions.3: Put the vegetables, fish steaks and lemon juice in a tagine or baking tray, season with salt and pepper and bake in a moderate oven until the fish is cooked.
instructions.4: Ladle onto an oblong plate and arrange the small boiled potatoes around it.

osool-417-i3.name: A little coarsely chopped pickled cucumber

osool-417-i6.name: For the sauce: water or fish stock

instructions.1: Clean the fish, remove the bones and skin, and place it in a tray greased with ghee.
instructions.2: Pour the lemon juice and water over it and cover the fish with greased paper.
instructions.3: Bring the liquid in the tray to a boil on the stove, then bake in a hot oven for 10 minutes until the fish is cooked; lift it out and arrange on a plate.
instructions.4: Make a white sauce with the remaining liquid, the flour and the ghee, and add a little coarsely chopped pickled cucumber.
instructions.5: Cover the fish with this sauce and garnish with lemon, parsley and cucumber.

osool-418.title: Fish Torly (Baked Fish with Mixed Vegetables)

instructions.1: Fry the fish in the oil and lift it out, then fry the chopped onion, then the chopped garlic.
instructions.2: Add the peeled, chopped tomatoes and stir briefly over the heat.
instructions.3: Pour in the water or stock and bring to a boil, then add the prepared vegetables and cook until tender.
instructions.4: Arrange the fish in a baking tray and cover with the vegetable mixture.
instructions.5: Bake in a fairly hot oven for 10 minutes until the fish is cooked.
instructions.6: Serve the fish and vegetables neatly and garnish with lemon and parsley.

osool-419-i4.name: Fish stock (from the fish bones) or water

instructions.1: Prepare the fish, cut it into steaks and remove the bones; make a stock from the bones.
instructions.2: Heat the oil until very hot, sauté the flour-dusted fish in it and lift it out.
instructions.3: Fry the onion in the oil, then add the washed freekeh and stir until browned.
instructions.4: Add the liquid to the freekeh and season; cover the pot and cook over low heat until half done.
instructions.5: Put half the freekeh in the tagine, then the fish, then the rest of the freekeh.
instructions.6: Sprinkle the top with a little very hot oil and bake the tagine in the oven until done.
instructions.7: Wrap a paper frill around the tagine, fix it with a pin and serve on a larger plate.

osool-420.title: Fried Sole with Nutmeg
osool-420.culturalNotes: Other kinds of fish can be seasoned with nutmeg instead of garlic and cumin.

instructions.1: Prepare the fish and season with salt, pepper, nutmeg and lemon juice for half an hour.
instructions.2: Coat in flour and shallow-fry in the oil.
instructions.3: Lift onto paper to absorb the oil and garnish with lemon and parsley.

osool-421-i1.name: Fish, boned and skinned, cut into medium slices

osool-421-i9.name: For the batter: whisked egg white

instructions.1: Marinate the fish for an hour in the mixture of oil, lemon, parsley, vinegar, salt and pepper.
instructions.2: For the batter: sift the flour with a pinch of salt, make a well in the center and add the oil, then add the water gradually while beating until smooth; leave for half an hour and fold in the whisked egg white just before using.
instructions.3: Lift out the pieces, pat dry and dust with a little flour, then coat each piece in batter.
instructions.4: Deep-fry in very hot oil, then lift the pieces onto paper to absorb the oil.
instructions.5: Arrange the fish on the plate, garnish with parsley and lemon and serve with tomato sauce.

osool-422-i2.name: Cumin, garlic and lemon juice (or nutmeg)

instructions.1: Cut up the fish and soak for 12 to 18 hours, changing the water.
instructions.2: Clean off the scales well, rinse and cut into suitable pieces.
instructions.3: Marinate in the cumin, garlic and lemon for half an hour, or season with nutmeg.
instructions.4: Coat in flour and fry in very hot oil.
instructions.5: Garnish with lemon and parsley and serve with tomato sauce.

osool-423-i3.name: Plenty of oil or ghee for deep-frying

instructions.1: Clean the basaria and season as you like.
instructions.2: Coat in flour and group them three or four at a time, pressing them together at the tails.
instructions.3: Fry in very hot oil.
instructions.4: Garnish with lemon and parsley.
instructions.5: Western style: put the cleaned basaria in ice water in the refrigerator, then dry them with a cloth; sprinkle a dry cloth with flour, lay the fish on it, sprinkle with more flour and shake until the flour sticks; shake them in a frying basket to remove the excess and fry in hot ghee for 3 to 4 minutes; season with salt and pepper and serve with lemon quarters.

instructions.1: Clean the fish, cut into steaks and season with salt, pepper, nutmeg and lemon juice.
instructions.2: Fry the fish in the oil.
instructions.3: Fry the potato rounds; peel the tomatoes (dip them in hot water for a minute, then press and slip off the skins), slice them into rounds and season.
instructions.4: Arrange the fish on the plate, placing a potato slice on one steak and a tomato round on the next, and so on alternately.
instructions.5: Pile the sautéed vegetables (peas and carrots) into small mounds on these rounds and garnish the plate with parsley and halved lemons.

instructions.1: Mix all the ingredients together well, add the butter or melted ghee and knead.
instructions.2: Shape into rounds, smooth them well and coat in egg and breadcrumbs.
instructions.3: Fry in very hot ghee or oil, then lift out and drain on paper.
instructions.4: Arrange neatly on the plate, garnish with lemon and parsley and serve hot or cold.
instructions.5: With mustard and cumin: add 1 level teaspoon mustard powder and a very little cumin to the mixture.
instructions.6: Fish croquettes in batter: roll the mixture out and cut into 3 cm pieces shaped like bottle corks; dust with flour, dip in batter and deep-fry; serve with tomato sauce.

instructions.1: Add the flaked fish, parsley and lemon juice to the white sauce, knead well and season with salt and pepper.
instructions.2: Spread it in a round on a greased or wetted plate and leave until cool.
instructions.3: Divide into 6 to 8 pieces and shape like cutlets; insert a piece of macaroni into the pointed end of each, then coat in egg and breadcrumbs.
instructions.4: Deep-fry.
instructions.5: Garnish with lemon and parsley and serve with tomato sauce.
instructions.6: Shrimp cutlets: chop ¼ kg boiled shrimp and add to half a measure of very thick white sauce with 1 tablespoon cream; season with lemon juice and pepper, and shape and serve like the fish cutlets.

osool-427-i10.name: Anchovy sauce or tomato sauce, for serving

instructions.1: Clean the fish, cut it into round steaks and remove the bones; pat dry and dust with a little flour.
instructions.2: Pound the shrimp in a mortar with the egg, breadcrumbs, chopped parsley, salt and pepper.
instructions.3: Spread the mixture over one side of each fish steak and smooth it completely; dip the steaks in flour on both sides, then coat in egg and breadcrumbs.
instructions.4: Deep-fry.
instructions.5: Serve with anchovy sauce or tomato sauce.

osool-428.title: Shrimp Kofta with Dill and Cumin

instructions.1: Wash the shrimp well several times, then peel them and pound until soft but not smooth.
instructions.2: Mix with the dill, parsley, ground rice and garlic to form a medium-soft paste.
instructions.3: Season with salt, pepper and cumin, shape into fingers, then coat the fingers in flour.
instructions.4: Fry in the oil, then simmer in the tomato sauce until cooked.
instructions.5: Ladle out hot.

osool-429-i1.name: Fish (mullet, sea bass, tilapia or sardines)

osool-429-i3.name: Or: pepper, nutmeg, lemon juice and a little oil

osool-429-i6.name: For the dressing: crushed garlic, salt, cumin and vinegar

instructions.1: Clean and prepare the fish; some kinds are grilled without cleaning, a method that is common especially among coastal people.
instructions.2: Season the fish with salt, garlic and cumin, or with salt, pepper, nutmeg, lemon juice and a little oil, or leave it unseasoned.
instructions.3: Put the grilling plate on the fire until hot.
instructions.4: Coat the fish in bran, or leave it uncoated (as with sardines), or brush it with oil or ghee before grilling (as with catfish).
instructions.5: Grill the fish, turning it on both sides.
instructions.6: Season the fish while hot, right after grilling: sprinkle with salt (as with sardines), or dip in salted water, or in a mixture of crushed garlic, salt and cumin mixed with vinegar to make a light dressing.
instructions.7: Eat cold or hot, garnished with lemon and parsley.

osool-430.title: Western-Style Grilled Fish with Parsley Butter

osool-430-i1.name: Fish, whole or cut into pieces no thicker than 1½ inches

osool-430-i3.name: Seasoned flour (1 tablespoon flour with ¼ teaspoon salt and a little pepper)

osool-430-i6.name: For the parsley butter: chopped parsley

osool-430-i7.name: For the parsley butter: lemon juice

osool-430-i8.name: For the parsley butter: salt, white pepper and a little paprika

instructions.1: Prepare the fish according to its type, leaving it whole or cutting it into thick pieces; dry the pieces well and salt them.
instructions.2: Brush with ghee or oil, or coat in the seasoned flour after brushing well with the fat.
instructions.3: Grill on both sides for 3 minutes right after brushing, then brush again, coat with breadcrumbs and finish grilling (about 5 minutes).
instructions.4: For the parsley butter: cream the butter and add the remaining ingredients, spread it flat on a plate and leave until cold, then cut into rounds when needed.
instructions.5: Eat the fish hot or cold, garnished with lemon and parsley, with the parsley butter placed on top.

osool-431.title: Whole Fish Stuffed with Raisins and Pine Nuts

instructions.1: Clean the fish, keeping it whole and intact, and season with salt, pepper and a tablespoon of lemon juice.
instructions.2: Fry the onion in the oil until lightly browned, then add the raisins and pine nuts; season this mixture with salt, pepper, allspice and the rest of the lemon juice.
instructions.3: Stuff the fish with the raisin mixture and sew it closed; place it in a tray with a little oil and cover with greased paper.
instructions.4: Bake in a moderate oven until done.
instructions.5: Carefully remove the thread, drain the fish of oil and place it on an oblong plate.
instructions.6: Garnish with lemon, parsley and the remaining raisin mixture.

osool-432.title: Baked Fish Stuffed with Spiced Mince and Pine Nuts

instructions.1: Clean the fish, keeping it intact, and season with salt, pepper and lemon juice.
instructions.2: Mix the asag with the pine nuts and parsley, stuff the fish with it and sew it closed.
instructions.3: Place in a tray with the oil, cover with greased paper and bake in a moderate oven until done.
instructions.4: Remove the thread and serve on an oblong plate garnished with lemon and parsley.
instructions.5: Fish with bread stuffing: clean a ¾ kg fish and season with salt, pepper and lemon; fill with bread stuffing (breadcrumbs, parsley, lemon zest, ghee and egg) and sew closed; season the outside, dust with flour and coat with egg and breadcrumbs; place in a tray with a little ghee and bake in a moderate oven for half an hour, basting with ghee, and serve with anchovy sauce.

osool-433.title: Baked Fish with Oil and Lemon

instructions.1: Prepare the fish and leave it whole; season with salt, pepper, cumin and lemon juice, adding a little garlic if you like.
instructions.2: Place in a tray greased with oil and pour over a little oil and as much lemon juice as you like; you can add a few peppers or autumn vegetables too.
instructions.3: Cover the tray with greased paper and bake in a moderate oven until the fish is done (10 to 15 minutes).
instructions.4: Sardines with oil and lemon: made the same way using sardines instead of fish.

osool-434.title: Sole Rolls in Lemon and Parsley Sauce

osool-434-i3.name: For the lemon and parsley sauce: white sauce made with white stock

osool-434-i4.name: For the lemon and parsley sauce: chopped parsley and lemon juice

instructions.1: Season the fish fillets with pepper and lemon juice.
instructions.2: Roll each fillet from head to tail with the skinned side inward, then secure with a small stick (such as a toothpick).
instructions.3: Arrange the rolls in a greased tray and cover with greased paper.
instructions.4: Bake in a moderate oven for 15 to 20 minutes.
instructions.5: Transfer to a plate, cover with the sauce and garnish with lemon and parsley.

osool-435.title: Baked Potatoes Stuffed with Fish, Shrimp and Cheese

instructions.1: Bake the potatoes in their skins, then hollow them out, removing much of the flesh.
instructions.2: Season the fish with lemon, salt and pepper; roll the fillets from head to tail with the skinned side inside and secure with a toothpick.
instructions.3: Place the fish in a greased tray, pour over the fish stock, milk or water, cover with greased paper and bake in a moderate oven for a quarter of an hour.
instructions.4: Fill the hollowed potatoes with alternating layers of sauce, cheese and shrimp, place a fish roll on top of each and sprinkle with breadcrumbs.
instructions.5: Place the potatoes on a plate lined with a folded napkin, garnish with a sprig of parsley and serve hot.

osool-436.title: Baked Sole Rolls Stuffed with Shrimp, with Mayonnaise

osool-436-i2.name: Shrimp cutlet mixture (boiled chopped shrimp with thick white sauce and cream)

osool-436-i6.name: Thin pickled cucumbers, tomatoes and fresh cucumber, for garnish

instructions.1: Season the fish fillets with lemon juice, salt and pepper.
instructions.2: Spread each fillet with the shrimp mixture, roll it from head to tail and secure.
instructions.3: Place in a greased tray and pour over a little water, stock or milk.
instructions.4: Bake in a moderate oven covered with greased paper until the fish is cooked, then leave to cool and arrange on a bed of lettuce.
instructions.5: Cover with the mayonnaise and garnish with thinly sliced pickled cucumber, tomatoes and unpeeled fresh cucumber rounds.

osool-437.title: Fish in a Mashed Potato Case

osool-437-i6.name: Potato purée for lining the mold

osool-437-i8.name: Ghee and breadcrumbs for the mold

instructions.1: Heat the fish and tomato sauce in a pan and season; this will fill the mold later.
instructions.2: Brush a plain mold with warm ghee, then coat it with a layer of breadcrumbs.
instructions.3: Line the mold (bottom and sides) with a layer of potato purée an inch thick, brush with beaten egg and bake in a hot oven for a quarter of an hour.
instructions.4: Carefully turn out the potato case onto a plate lined with a lace doily.
instructions.5: Fill the hollow of the potato case with the hot fish and sauce mixture.
instructions.6: Garnish with parsley and lemon or with piped rosettes of potato purée.

osool-438-i4.name: Ghee and breadcrumbs for the mold

instructions.1: Mix all the ingredients together and season well.
instructions.2: Brush a plain mold with warm ghee, then sprinkle with breadcrumbs.
instructions.3: Fill the mold with the mixture and cover with greased paper.
instructions.4: Bake in a moderate oven for half an hour.
instructions.5: Turn out of the mold, pour the tomato sauce around it and garnish with parsley.
instructions.6: Mashed fish bake: spread the fish croquette mixture in a round greased tray coated with breadcrumbs, smooth the top and brush with egg; bake in a moderate oven until the top browns, then turn out and serve.

osool-439.title: Fish in Scallop Shells with Cheese Sauce

osool-439-i2.name: Cheese sauce (white sauce with grated rumi cheese)

instructions.1: Grease the scallop shells with ghee, then fill with layers of fish and sauce, finishing with a layer of sauce.
instructions.2: Sprinkle the top with a few breadcrumbs, then put a small piece of butter on each.
instructions.3: Bake in a moderate oven for 15 minutes.
instructions.4: Garnish the shells with lemon and parsley and serve on a plate covered with a folded napkin or a lace doily.

osool-440.title: Baked Fish with Tomato White Sauce

instructions.1: Clean the fish, cut it into slices 1½ inches thick and season with salt and pepper.
instructions.2: Arrange in a tray, put a small piece of butter on each slice and cover with greased paper.
instructions.3: Bake in a moderate oven until done.
instructions.4: Add the strained tomatoes and the liquid left in the tray after cooking the fish to the white sauce.
instructions.5: Arrange the fish on a plate, cover with the sauce and sprinkle with chopped parsley.

osool-441.title: Italian-Style Fish with Macaroni and Cheese

instructions.1: Remove the skin and bones from the fish, cut into small, suitable pieces and season with salt and pepper.
instructions.2: Grease an ovenproof dish well with ghee, then fill with alternating layers of fish, macaroni and rumi cheese.
instructions.3: Dot the top with the butter cut into small pieces and bake in a hot oven for 20 minutes.
instructions.4: Serve with tomato sauce.

osool-442.title: Sole with Hollandaise Sauce and Pea Purée

instructions.1: Season the fish fillets with salt, pepper and lemon juice.
instructions.2: Peel and chop the shrimp and mix with a little hollandaise sauce.
instructions.3: Lay out the fish fillets, spread with a layer of the shrimp mixture and fold each in three.
instructions.4: Place the folded fish on a greased tray, pour a little water around it, cover with greased paper and bake in a moderate oven for 15 to 20 minutes.
instructions.5: Make a bed of the pea and potato purées.
instructions.6: Lift the fish out of the tray, drain well and arrange on the bed.
instructions.7: Cover the fish with the rest of the hollandaise sauce and garnish with rosettes of potato and pea purée and a few peeled shrimp.

instructions.1: Clean and wash the fish, cut into steaks and remove the bones.
instructions.2: Heat the oil until very hot, sauté the fish in it and lift it out.
instructions.3: Fry the chopped onions in the remaining oil until browned, then take off the heat.
instructions.4: Thin the tahini with a little water and add the lemon or vinegar, salt, pepper and garlic.
instructions.5: Add the tahini to the browned onions, stir well and heat gently for 5 minutes.
instructions.6: Arrange the fish in a baking tray or ovenproof dish, pour the tahini sauce over it and bake in a moderate oven until done.
instructions.7: Serve in its dish or transfer to a plate, garnished with lemon and parsley.
instructions.8: Second method: make a stock from the fish bones with a piece of celery, an onion and 1½ cups water boiled for 10 minutes, then strain; slice ½ kg onions into thin rings and sauté in 2 tablespoons oil until golden; lay the fish, seasoned with salt, pepper, cumin and lemon, on top; thin ¼ kg tahini with the stock, season, pour over the fish and bake until done.
instructions.9: Third method: fry ¼ kg finely chopped onion in 2 tablespoons oil, add 1 tablespoon white grape vinegar and let the onion absorb it, then add ¼ small cup water, then ¼ small cup tahini while stirring; add lemon, salt and 1½ tablespoons of asag (spiced cooked mince); stuff a whole mullet or sea bass with asag and 2 tablespoons pine nuts and a little of the sauce, cover with the sauce and bake in a moderate oven.

osool-444.title: Steamed Fish
osool-444.culturalNotes: A light, easily digested dish suitable for the sick and convalescent.

osool-444-i2.name: Butter or ghee for greasing the plate

instructions.1: Season the fish as you like, place it on a greased plate and cover with another greased plate.
instructions.2: Steam it between the two plates (over a pot of boiling water) for half an hour.
instructions.3: Serve on the plate it was cooked on, garnished with lemon and parsley.

instructions.1: Add the breadcrumbs and milk to the butter and stir over low heat until the mixture thickens.
instructions.2: Clean and wash the fish, then remove the skin and bones and weigh it.
instructions.3: Mince the fish finely and add it to the sauce, then pound everything well in a mortar.
instructions.4: Press the mixture through a clean wire sieve, season with salt and pepper, then add the cream and the whisked egg white.
instructions.5: Pour into a greased mold, cover with greased paper and steam for half an hour to three quarters of an hour.
instructions.6: Turn out onto a plate and garnish with lemon and parsley; it can be served with white sauce.
instructions.7: Second method: make a thick white sauce with 1 tablespoon butter, 1 tablespoon flour and ½ cup fish stock; add ¼ kg minced, pounded and sieved bayad fish, 2 beaten eggs, 1 cup cream, lemon juice, salt and pepper; steam in a greased mold for half an hour, turn out and cover with white sauce or béchamel.

osool-446.title: Steamed Fish Pudding with Anchovy Sauce

instructions.1: Cut the fish into pieces, mix all the ingredients together thoroughly and season.
instructions.2: Put into a greased mold, cover with greased paper and steam for half an hour.
instructions.3: Turn out onto a plate, cover with anchovy sauce or with white sauce with lemon and parsley, and garnish with lemon and parsley.
instructions.4: Second method: cut ½ kg cooked fish into small pieces and mix with 3 tablespoons breadcrumbs, 1 tablespoon parsley, salt and pepper; bind with ½ cup milk, 2 eggs, 2 tablespoons melted butter and 1 teaspoon anchovy essence; pour into a greased mold sprinkled with breadcrumbs, steam for 30 to 40 minutes and serve with tomato sauce.
instructions.5: Third method: mix ¼ kg cooked, cut-up fish with 1 small cup boiled rice and a little lemon juice; bind with 2 beaten eggs and 1 cup milk; pour into a greased mold whose base is decorated with slices of boiled egg, steam for an hour, turn out and pour a little tomato sauce around it.

osool-601.title: Boiled Dried White Beans, Served Several Ways
osool-601.culturalNotes: Legumes are so rich in protein that they have been called the poor man's meat, but they are low in fat, so some fat is added during cooking.

osool-601-i4.name: For the bean salad: large onion, chopped

osool-601-i5.name: For the bean salad: finely chopped garlic

osool-601-i6.name: For the bean salad: chopped parsley

osool-601-i7.name: French dressing (oil, lemon, salt and pepper)

instructions.1: Pick over the beans and wash repeatedly in cold water, then soak for 12 hours.
instructions.2: Rinse, then boil in boiling water with a small onion, changing the water if needed, and simmer over low heat until nearly tender.
instructions.3: Add the salt and finish cooking, then drain.
instructions.4: Bean salad: rub the chopped onion with salt and pepper and rinse it, add it to the remaining ingredients and dress the salad with the French dressing.
instructions.5: With oil and lemon: dress the boiled beans with lemon French dressing and leave for a while, then garnish with chopped parsley and tomato slices.
instructions.6: Sautéed: melt the butter, add the boiled beans with salt and pepper, stir briefly over the heat, then sprinkle with chopped parsley and serve.
instructions.7: Purée: mash the boiled beans with butter and milk, as for mashed potatoes.
instructions.8: Stewed: boil ½ kg beans until two-thirds cooked and drain; add to an onion base (onion fried in ghee with meat and tomatoes) and cook over low heat until tender.
instructions.9: Dried black-eyed peas: cooked in all these ways with the same quantities.

osool-602.title: Dried Black-Eyed Peas with Chard Paste

osool-602-i3.name: Onion rubbed with salt and pepper

instructions.1: Boil the black-eyed peas until two-thirds cooked and discard the cooking water.
instructions.2: Boil the meat in boiling water with an onion rubbed with salt and pepper until nearly tender.
instructions.3: Add the black-eyed peas to the meat and cook until fully done.
instructions.4: Wash the chard, remove the ribs and shred; fry briefly in the ghee, then add the chopped garlic and stir until golden; mash well until smooth.
instructions.5: Add the green paste to the black-eyed peas and boil for 5 minutes.

osool-603.title: Boiled Dried Peas, Served Several Ways

instructions.1: Pick over the peas, wash repeatedly in cold water and soak in cold water for 12 hours.
instructions.2: Rinse off the soaking water and boil in boiling water with an onion and two sprigs of fresh mint; when nearly done, add the salt and cook until tender.
instructions.3: Drain and use as desired.
instructions.4: With oil and lemon: dress like green peas with French dressing, using half the amount.
instructions.5: Sautéed: toss in butter over low heat and season.
instructions.6: Purée: press through a sieve, add the butter, salt and pepper and stir over low heat until thick.
instructions.7: Stewed: made like stewed green peas with an onion base (onion, meat and tomatoes in ghee).

osool-604.title: Ta'meya (Falafel) from Peeled Sprouted Fava Beans

instructions.1: To sprout: choose good dried white fava beans, pick over and wash, and soak in cold water for 3 days, changing the water twice a day; then drain, cover with a damp cloth for 12 hours and peel.
instructions.2: Wash the greens, peel the onions and garlic and chop everything coarsely.
instructions.3: Mix all the ingredients and pass through the fine plate of a meat mincer twice; pound if necessary.
instructions.4: Add the spices and adjust the salt; you can add a pinch of baking soda or leave the mixture to rest for half an hour.
instructions.5: Shape the ta'meya into even patties and sprinkle a little sesame on top, wetting your hand with a little water to help.
instructions.6: Fry in the oil and serve hot, garnished with parsley.

osool-605-i3.name: A piece of celery and a sprig of fresh mint

instructions.1: Pick over and wash the beans, cover with water and boil for 5 minutes, then discard the water.
instructions.2: Add fresh water, the thinly sliced onions, the celery and the mint to the beans.
instructions.3: Cook over low heat without stirring, adding more water whenever it dries out and skimming off the foam, until the beans are completely broken down.
instructions.4: Press the beans through a fine strainer; add the salt, spices, dried molokhia, dried mint and caraway, and boil while stirring, adding a little water if needed to get the right consistency.
instructions.5: Add the asag to the bessara, keeping some back to garnish the top.
instructions.6: For the taqliya: heat the ghee until very hot and fry the chopped onions until golden; remove half for garnish, then add the crushed garlic and coriander to the rest and stir quickly until the mixture is light reddish-brown.
instructions.7: Pour the taqliya over the bessara and stir again, adding a little chili if desired.
instructions.8: Ladle into plates and let cool slightly, then garnish with the remaining fried onions and asag.

osool-606.title: Oven-Cooked Ful Medames, Served Several Ways

osool-606-i3.name: Water
osool-606-i3.standardAmount: to fill ¾ of the pot

osool-606-i4.name: Oil and lemon, or ghee, for serving

osool-606-i5.name: For the ful salad: sliced green onion, chopped garlic, chopped parsley and tomato rounds

osool-606-i6.name: For ful with tomatoes: chopped onion, tomatoes, garlic and ghee

osool-606-i7.name: For ful with spiced mince: asag

instructions.1: Choose good-quality dried white fava beans, pick over carefully and wash well.
instructions.2: Put them in a pot (qidra) and add a very little yellow lentils if desired.
instructions.3: Fill the pot three-quarters full with water, then cover it tightly and tie the lid, or seal it with dough.
instructions.4: Put it in a low oven for 8 to 10 hours.
instructions.5: Let the pot cool down before opening it, since the trapped steam inside could burst out.
instructions.6: Serve the beans with oil and lemon or with ghee.
instructions.7: Ful medames salad: mix the beans with green onion, garlic, parsley and tomato rounds and season with salt, pepper, oil and lemon.
instructions.8: Ful medames with tomatoes: fry a chopped onion in ghee, then the garlic and coriander; add strained tomatoes and cook until thick, then add the ful and stir for 5 to 10 minutes.
instructions.9: Ful medames with spiced mince: as for ful with tomatoes, adding 2 tablespoons asag.

osool-607.title: Sprouted Fava Beans in Tomato Sauce

instructions.1: Pick over the peeled beans and wash well.
instructions.2: Fry the onion in the oil or ghee, and when it turns golden, add the crushed garlic and coriander.
instructions.3: Add the strained tomatoes and cook until thickened, then add the beans and stir for 5 to 10 minutes.
instructions.4: Add some water, cover the pot and cook over medium heat until the beans are tender, adding a little water whenever needed.
instructions.5: A tablespoon of rice can be added to the beans shortly before they are done.
instructions.6: Add the chopped parsley, if using, and boil with the beans for two minutes.
instructions.7: Boiled sprouted fava beans: wash the beans and boil in boiling water with a small onion and lemon juice until tender; serve with oil and lemon.

osool-608.title: Fuliya (Sprouted Fava Beans with Greens and Rice)

osool-608-i2.name: A bunch of greens (dill, fresh coriander and chard)

instructions.1: Chop the onion finely and fry in a little oil, then add some water and bring the pot to a boil.
instructions.2: Peel, wash and pick over the beans, add to the boiling water and cook until nearly tender.
instructions.3: Wash the rice and add it to the beans before they are fully done; cook until both are tender.
instructions.4: Prepare the greens and fry them in the rest of the oil, then fry the chopped garlic.
instructions.5: Pour the oil over the beans; crush the greens well, add them to the beans and bring to a boil.

osool-609.title: Sprouted Fava Bean Fatta with Vinegar and Garlic

osool-609-i1.name: Sprouted fava bean soup (beans boiled with mastic and lemon)

instructions.1: Make the sprouted fava bean soup and lift the beans out of it.
instructions.2: Break the toasted bread into suitable pieces, pour the soup over it, cover and leave for 5 to 10 minutes.
instructions.3: Layer the soaked bread and the cooked beans on a plate.
instructions.4: Chop a little garlic and fry it in the ghee, then add a little vinegar and leave on the heat briefly.
instructions.5: Add it to the fatta, then garnish the top with cooked beans and serve hot.
instructions.6: Lentil fatta: make Egyptian lentil soup and break up toasted bread; pour the soup over the bread and cover for 5 to 10 minutes, then make the garlic-vinegar taqliya with ghee, pour it over the fatta and serve hot.

osool-610.title: Sprouted Fava Bean and Tahini Dip (Mohawwag)

instructions.1: Pick over the peeled beans and wash well; put in a pot with the onion, garlic and enough water to cover.
instructions.2: Cook over low heat until the beans are tender and completely broken down.
instructions.3: Press the beans through a fine strainer or wire sieve and add the salt and cumin.
instructions.4: Add the vinegar, 2 tablespoons tahini and the chopped parsley to the sieved beans and mix.
instructions.5: Ladle into plates and let cool, then decorate the top by drizzling the remaining tahini in thin threads.
instructions.6: Sprouted fava bean salad with vegetables: peel ¼ qadah sprouted beans, boil and let cool; add a tomato and a medium onion sliced into rounds and a sweet green pepper cut into rings; dress with French dressing and garnish with parsley.

osool-611.title: Lentils with Rice and Spiced Mince

instructions.1: Pick the lentils clean of stones and grit and wash several times in cold water.
instructions.2: Peel and cut up the onion and garlic and put them in a pot with the lentils; cover with water or stock and cook over low heat until tender, adding water as needed; the tomato can be added while boiling.
instructions.3: Press through a wire sieve or fine strainer and season with salt and cumin; the consistency should be fairly thin.
instructions.4: Bring to a boil, add the washed rice and cook until the rice is done.
instructions.5: Take off the heat, add the asag and serve hot.

instructions.1: Put the lentils, ghee, onion, tomato and water or stock in a pot and cook over low heat until tender, adding water if needed; then press through a wire sieve or fine strainer.
instructions.2: Bring the sieved lentils to a boil, add the ground rice and cook over low heat until the rice is done.
instructions.3: Spread the mixture on a greased round plate and leave until cold.
instructions.4: Cut into 6 to 8 pieces and shape like cutlets, inserting a piece of macaroni into the pointed end of each.
instructions.5: Coat in egg and breadcrumbs and deep-fry in plenty of ghee.
instructions.6: Serve with tomato sauce and garnish with parsley.
instructions.7: Lentil molds: put the same mixture into one mold or several small ones, well greased with ghee and coated with a few breadcrumbs; cook in the oven or steam for an hour, then turn out and pour tomato sauce around.

osool-613.title: Brown Lentils: Boiled, Slow-Cooked and as a Salad

osool-613-i5.name: For the lentil salad: onions sliced into thin rings

osool-613-i6.name: For the lentil salad: chopped parsley

instructions.1: Pick the lentils clean of stones and grit and wash several times in cold water.
instructions.2: Boiled: bring the water to a boil, add the lentils and cook until nearly tender, then add the salt; let cool slightly, then drain.
instructions.3: With oil and lemon: add some oil and lemon to the cold boiled lentils and serve.
instructions.4: Slow-cooked (medammes): put the lentils in a pot, cover with water, close the lid tightly and cook over low heat until tender, adding a little water as needed; add the salt near the end, then ladle out and add ghee or oil.
instructions.5: Lentil salad: rub the onions well with salt and pepper and rinse in cold water; mix everything with the boiled lentils, dress with the French dressing, spoon onto a plate and garnish with chopped parsley.

osool-614.title: Fluffy Freekeh and Freekeh in Poultry Stock

instructions.1: Pick the freekeh clean of stones and wash well.
instructions.2: Brown it in very hot ghee.
instructions.3: Add the water and salt and cook over low heat until tender.
instructions.4: Freekeh cooked in stock: made the same way using poultry stock instead of water; serve with boiled or roasted poultry.

instructions.1: Pick the rice clean of stones and wash several times in cold water until the water runs clear.
instructions.2: Heat the ghee until very hot, add the water, tomato juice and salt and bring to a boil.
instructions.3: Add the rice to the boiling liquid and cook for 5 minutes over high heat, then lower the heat and cook until done.
instructions.4: Serve heaped in a mound on a plate, or pressed into a mold and turned out onto a plate.
instructions.5: Second method: heat 2 tablespoons ghee until very hot, add ¼ cup tomato juice and stir over low heat for a few minutes; add 1½ cups boiling water, season with salt, add the cup of washed rice and finish as above.

osool-802.title: Rice Mold with Fried Kidneys or Liver

osool-802-i1.name: Fluffy rice (stirred in ghee until it crackles, then cooked in water)

osool-802-i2.name: Fried lamb kidneys (or ¼ kg fried liver)

instructions.1: Make the fluffy rice: heat the ghee until very hot and stir the washed rice in it until it crackles, then add 2 cups hot water and the salt; cook for 7 minutes over high heat, then lower the heat until done.
instructions.2: Cut the fried kidneys into medium-thick slices and arrange them in the bottom of a mold.
instructions.3: Fill the mold with the rice and press it down.
instructions.4: Turn the mold out onto a plate and serve hot.
instructions.5: Rice with liver: made the same way using ¼ kg fried liver instead of kidneys.
instructions.6: Rice with meat: spoon the fluffy rice onto a plate in a hollow ring, or press it into a ring mold and turn it out; fill the center with pot kebab and serve hot.

osool-803.title: Rice Mold with Peas, Carrots and Spiced Mince

osool-803-i4.name: Asag (spiced cooked mince) or chopped fried liver

instructions.1: Mix the peas and carrot into the rice while hot.
instructions.2: Put the asag or liver in the bottom of a mold.
instructions.3: Press the rice mixture into the mold over the asag or liver layer and turn it out onto a plate.
instructions.4: Serve the rice with the tomato sauce in a sauceboat.

osool-804-i2.name: A pair of pigeons or 6 quail

osool-804-i3.name: The pigeon or quail cooking broth

instructions.1: Boil the birds in water with the mastic, cardamom and salt until tender, and keep the broth.
instructions.2: Heat the ghee until very hot, add the broth and salt and bring to a boil.
instructions.3: Add the washed rice and cook for 5 minutes over high heat, then lower the heat until done.
instructions.4: Brown the boiled birds in a little ghee, and cut the pigeons into quarters.
instructions.5: Spoon out the rice and garnish with the browned pigeons or quail and parsley.

osool-805.title: Baked Rice with Milk and Poultry (Roz Me'ammar)

instructions.1: Clean the birds and leave whole or cut into halves or quarters; season well with salt and pepper.
instructions.2: Grease a clay tagine or ovenproof dish well with half the ghee.
instructions.3: Put in half the rice, then the birds, then the rest of the rice, and pour over the milk seasoned with salt.
instructions.4: Bake in a moderate oven until nearly done.
instructions.5: Heat the rest of the ghee until very hot and drizzle it over the top, then return the tagine to the oven until done and browned on top.
instructions.6: Serve in the tagine or turn out onto a plate.

osool-806.title: White Rice Pilaf with Giblets and Nuts
osool-806.culturalNotes: This rice is served with large birds such as turkey and goose, or with lamb chops.

osool-806-i4.name: Poultry liver and gizzard, cut up

instructions.1: Pick over the pine nuts; remove the raisin stems, wash and dry them completely; peel the almonds and hazelnuts and cut into halves or quarters; pick over and wash the rice.
instructions.2: Heat the ghee until very hot, fry the liver and gizzard in it and lift out.
instructions.3: Fry the hazelnuts and almonds in the remaining ghee until golden, then add the raisins and pine nuts and stir until browned; lift out the nuts and drain off the ghee.
instructions.4: Add the rice to the ghee and stir until it crackles.
instructions.5: Add the stock, season with salt and bring to a boil.
instructions.6: Add the nuts (keeping a few for the garnish) and fold gently into the rice; lower the heat until done.
instructions.7: Spoon onto a plate and garnish with the liver, gizzard and nuts.
instructions.8: Dark rice pilaf: the same ingredients with 3 to 4 tablespoons ghee and a chopped medium onion; brown the rice well in the ghee until dark and drain off the excess ghee; fry the onion in 1 tablespoon ghee until reddish brown, add the stock, boil well and strain; then add the browned rice and nuts and cook over low heat.

instructions.1: Pick over and wash the rice.
instructions.2: Cook it in the milk over low heat until tender.
instructions.3: Add 3 level tablespoons of the rumi cheese and season the mixture with salt and pepper.
instructions.4: Pour into a greased ovenproof dish and sprinkle the top with the rest of the cheese.
instructions.5: Bake in a hot oven until the top browns.

instructions.1: Bring plenty of water to a boil, add the salt and then the pasta, and cook uncovered until done (20 to 40 minutes depending on the type).
instructions.2: Drain the pasta, add the butter while hot and toss gently.
instructions.3: Spoon onto a plate and serve with the sauce in a sauceboat and the grated cheese in a small glass dish.

osool-809.title: Baked Pasta with Tomatoes and Cheese

instructions.1: Peel the tomatoes, slice into rounds and season with salt and pepper.
instructions.2: Layer the pasta in a greased ovenproof dish alternately with the tomato slices and rumi cheese, finishing with cheese on top.
instructions.3: Sprinkle the top with the fine breadcrumbs and dot with the butter at intervals.
instructions.4: Bake in a hot oven until browned on top.

osool-810.title: Baked Macaroni in White Sauce with Cheese

instructions.1: Mix the rumi cheese into the white sauce, keeping back 1 tablespoon for the top.
instructions.2: Mix the pasta with the cheese sauce (keeping a little sauce for the top) and toss well; season with salt and pepper.
instructions.3: Pour into an ovenproof dish greased with ghee.
instructions.4: Cover the top with the remaining sauce and sprinkle with the cheese, then the breadcrumbs.
instructions.5: Dot with the butter at intervals and bake in a hot oven until browned.
instructions.6: With mustard: made the same way, adding ½ teaspoon mustard to the white sauce and cheese; the cheese can be increased to 9 tablespoons.

osool-811.title: Baked Pasta with Egg Sauce and Spiced Mince

osool-811-i2.name: White sauce (made with milk, or half milk and half pasta cooking water)

osool-811-i7.name: Salt, pepper and a pinch of cinnamon

instructions.1: Make the white sauce and let it cool somewhat, then add the lightly beaten eggs, mix well and adjust the seasoning.
instructions.2: Grease the tray with ghee and put in half the pasta, then the asag, then the rest of the pasta; smooth the top well.
instructions.3: Cover the top with the sauce, sprinkle with breadcrumbs and dot with the ghee.
instructions.4: Bake in a hot oven until browned on top.

osool-812-i2.name: White sauce made with the pasta cooking water

osool-812-i6.name: Grated rumi cheese and tomato sauce, for serving (optional)

instructions.1: Make the white sauce using the pasta cooking water instead of milk.
instructions.2: Let the sauce cool somewhat, then add the lightly beaten eggs, stir well and season.
instructions.3: Put the boiled pasta in a greased tray, smooth the top completely and cover with the sauce.
instructions.4: Bake in a hot oven until browned on top.
instructions.5: It is usually served with grated rumi cheese and tomato sauce.

instructions.1: Mix the tomato sauce into the white sauce, add the rumi cheese and ghee and season.
instructions.2: Add the pasta while hot and toss together.
instructions.3: Heap onto a plate and serve hot.

osool-814.title: Pasta with Tomato and Spiced Mince (Stovetop or Baked)

instructions.1: Make the asag with the ghee, onion and minced meat.
instructions.2: Add the tomatoes and cook until done, then add some water and bring to a boil.
instructions.3: Add the asag to the boiled pasta and mix gently.
instructions.4: Spoon onto a plate and serve hot.
instructions.5: Baked: put half the pasta in a greased tray or ovenproof dish with the asag in the middle, then the rest of the pasta; heat 1 tablespoon ghee until very hot, drizzle over the top and bake in a hot oven until browned.

osool-815-i3.name: Pasta with spiced mince or French-style pasta

instructions.1: Grease an oblong cake tin or a medium round tray with ghee.
instructions.2: Line the bottom and sides of the tin with phyllo (keeping a few sheets for the top), sprinkling melted ghee between the layers.
instructions.3: Put the pasta into the prepared tin, cover the top with phyllo the same way and sprinkle the top with ghee.
instructions.4: Bake in a hot oven until the phyllo is golden.
instructions.5: Let it cool slightly, then turn out onto a plate and serve.

osool-816.title: Baked Pasta in an Egg and Breadcrumb Crust

osool-816-i1.name: Pasta with spiced mince and tomato

instructions.1: Grease the tray well with warm ghee.
instructions.2: Sprinkle with the breadcrumbs to coat the bottom and sides evenly.
instructions.3: Lightly beat 2 eggs and pour them into the tray over the breadcrumbs to coat them.
instructions.4: Beat the other 2 eggs and mix them into the pasta, adding the grated cheese if using.
instructions.5: Put the pasta mixture into the prepared tray and bake in a hot oven until browned on top.
instructions.6: Let the tray cool somewhat, then turn out onto a plate and serve.

osool-817-i1.name: Cut pasta, orzo (lisan asfour) or small shells

instructions.1: Fry the pasta in very hot ghee until golden.
instructions.2: Bring the stock or water to a boil, add it to the browned pasta, season with salt and cook until done.
instructions.3: Add more stock or water if needed; the amount varies with the type of pasta.

osool-818.title: Toad in the Hole (Sausages Baked in Batter)

osool-818-i2.name: For the simple English batter: flour

instructions.1: For the batter: mix the salt with the flour and sift; make a well in the center and add the egg, then two-thirds of the milk, stirring constantly until thick and free of lumps; beat well for 5 to 10 minutes and leave for at least half an hour in a well-ventilated place; then add the rest of the milk, beat and season.
instructions.2: Prick the sausages with a fork and put them in a greased tray in the oven for 10 minutes, or sauté them.
instructions.3: Cut the sausages in half or into medium pieces.
instructions.4: Grease the tray or ovenproof dish well with ghee, arrange the sausages in it and pour the batter over them.
instructions.5: Bake in a hot oven for 20 minutes.
instructions.6: Serve hot, cut into suitable pieces on a plate, or whole in the baking dish.
instructions.7: Steak in batter: replace the sausages with very thinly sliced steak seasoned with salt and pepper, and make it like the sausages in batter.

osool-701.title: Zucchini Dolma (Stuffed with Rice, Cooked in Oil)
osool-701.culturalNotes: Dolma is a meatless stuffed vegetable dish cooked in oil; it is good served cold.

osool-701-i2.name: For the dolma filling: finely chopped onions

osool-701-i5.name: For the dolma filling: chopped parsley

osool-701-i6.name: For the dolma filling: chopped mint or a little dried mint

instructions.1: For the dolma filling: fry the onions lightly in the oil, then add the washed rice and stir over low heat; add the strained tomatoes and stir until the rice absorbs the juice, then add the mint and parsley and stir for two minutes; season with salt, pepper and allspice and leave to cool.
instructions.2: Wash, scrape and hollow out the zucchini, season the insides with salt and fill with the mixture, leaving about an inch unfilled.
instructions.3: Slice the celery, carrots and onion into rounds, leave the garlic whole and mix everything together.
instructions.4: Put some of the sliced vegetables in the bottom of the pot, then arrange a layer of zucchini and another of vegetables, and so on.
instructions.5: Add some water to the strained tomatoes, season the mixture and pour it over the zucchini, then add the oil.
instructions.6: Cover the pot and cook over low heat until done, adding a little salted water when needed; add the cardamom a few minutes before it is done.
instructions.7: Spoon onto a plate, garnish with the whole cooked carrot rounds and serve hot or cold.

osool-702-i2.name: Dolma filling (onion, rice, oil, parsley, mint and tomatoes)

osool-702-i5.name: Two carrots, a piece of celery and an onion (sliced into rounds)

instructions.1: Peel the eggplants lightly, then cut off the cap with a small piece of the top and hollow them out to remove all the seeds.
instructions.2: Leave in salted water for half an hour, then drain.
instructions.3: Fill with the dolma mixture, leaving the top part unfilled.
instructions.4: Arrange the vegetable rounds in the bottom of the pot and the eggplants on top; pour over the strained tomatoes, salted water and oil.
instructions.5: Cover the pot and cook over low heat until done, adding a little water whenever needed.
instructions.6: Arrange neatly on a plate, garnish with parsley and serve hot or cold.
instructions.7: White eggplant dolma: made with the same ingredients and method.

osool-703-i2.name: For the raw filling: minced meat

osool-703-i4.name: For the raw filling: large onion, chopped

osool-703-i5.name: For the raw filling: chopped parsley and mint

osool-703-i6.name: For the raw filling: chopped tomatoes

instructions.1: For the raw filling: rub the onion with salt and pepper; pick over, wash and drain the rice; mix all the ingredients and season with salt, pepper and allspice.
instructions.2: Wash and hollow out the cucumbers (do not scrape them) and salt the insides.
instructions.3: Fill with the mixture and arrange in a pot.
instructions.4: Pour over the strained tomatoes mixed with a little salted water, and add the ghee.
instructions.5: Cover the pot and cook over low heat until done, adding a little water whenever needed.
instructions.6: Spoon onto a plate with the sauce around it, and garnish with parsley if you like.
instructions.7: Snake cucumber stuffed with freekeh: made as above using freekeh instead of rice, and without the tomatoes.
instructions.8: Stuffed cucumbers: made like the snake cucumbers with the raw filling.

osool-704-i2.name: Raw filling (minced meat, rice, onion, parsley and tomatoes) or ¼ kg asag with tomatoes

instructions.1: Peel and hollow out the onions and soak in salted water for half an hour.
instructions.2: Drain and season the insides with a little salt and pepper.
instructions.3: Fill with the chosen filling; the raw filling is best.
instructions.4: Arrange in a pot and pour over the ghee and the tomatoes mixed with a little salted water.
instructions.5: Set over low heat, cover the pot and cook until done.
instructions.6: Spoon onto a plate, pour the sauce around and garnish with parsley.

osool-705-i2.name: Asag with tomatoes or raw filling
osool-705-i2.standardAmount: ½ kg asag or half a batch of filling

instructions.1: Cut the white part of the leeks into pieces about 8 cm long.
instructions.2: Hollow them out, stuff them and finish like stuffed onions: arrange in a pot, pour over the ghee and the tomatoes with a little salted water, and cook covered over low heat until done.
instructions.3: Second method: cut the white parts into 6 cm lengths and boil briefly in salted water; slit lengthwise down one side and carefully separate the layers; put a little filling on each layer and roll it up like a finger; arrange in a small pot, pour over the tomatoes mixed with a little salted water, cook, then turn out into a deep dish and serve hot.

instructions.1: Separate the lettuce leaves, wash well and carefully remove the thick rib from the center of each leaf.
instructions.2: Bring some salted water to a boil, add a batch of lettuce leaves for two minutes, then lift into a colander; repeat until all the leaves are done.
instructions.3: Stuff as fingers, as with cabbage, or as triangles, with the smooth side outward.
instructions.4: Arrange in a pot and put on the heat; after five minutes add a little salted liquid, the lemon juice if using, and the ghee or oil.
instructions.5: Cook over low heat until done.
instructions.6: Serve hot, or cold if using dolma filling, with a yogurt salad.
instructions.7: Stuffed chard leaves: choose wide leaves, prepare them like lettuce leaves, dip in salted boiling water and lift out quickly; stuff exactly like lettuce leaves, using only the raw filling and more lemon juice.
instructions.8: Stuffed spinach leaves: choose wide leaves and prepare exactly like chard leaves; stuff like lettuce leaves and leave out the lemon.

instructions.1: Choose the large, leafy kind; remove the thick stems, dip in salted boiling water and lift out.
instructions.2: Spread out on the table or your hand, arrange the fronds and press them flat by hand.
instructions.3: Put a little of the raw filling or asag on it and roll the dill tightly into fingers.
instructions.4: Arrange in a pot, put the ghee on top and set on the heat for five minutes.
instructions.5: Add a little salted water, cover with paper greased with ghee and then with the pot lid.
instructions.6: Cook over low heat until done, adding a little salted water whenever needed.

osool-708-i2.name: Dolma filling (onion, rice, oil, parsley, mint and tomatoes)

instructions.1: Wash the grape leaves repeatedly in cold water, then spread them out and stack them in piles.
instructions.2: Blanch each pile in boiling water with a little salt, then lift out carefully into a colander.
instructions.3: Cut the stem off each leaf and lay it flat with the smooth side outward; put a little dolma filling on it and roll it up like a finger.
instructions.4: Line the bottom of the pot with a layer of grape leaves, arrange the stuffed leaves neatly on top and put the oil over them.
instructions.5: Put the pot on the heat for 3 minutes, then add a little salted water; cook until nearly done, then add the lemon juice.
instructions.6: Arrange neatly on a plate or turn out of the pot, and serve cold with a yogurt salad.

osool-709.title: Levantine Stuffed Grape Leaves with Lamb Trotters

instructions.1: Prepare the grape leaves by washing them and blanching them in batches in salted boiling water.
instructions.2: Chop the onion and rub with salt and pepper, then add the washed rice, ghee and meat and mix everything well; season with salt, pepper and a little lemon juice and roll the leaves around it like fingers.
instructions.3: Take the trotter meat off the bone as far as possible.
instructions.4: Put a layer of trotter meat in the bottom of the pot, then arrange half the stuffed leaves on top.
instructions.5: Add another layer of trotter meat and cover with the rest of the stuffed leaves.
instructions.6: Set the pot over low heat, then pour a little trotter broth over.
instructions.7: Cook until nearly done, then add the lemon juice.
instructions.8: Serve the stuffed leaves with the trotter meat, hot.

osool-710.title: Stuffed Tomatoes (with Meat or Dolma Filling)

osool-710-i2.name: Raw filling (minced meat, rice, onion and parsley) or dolma filling

osool-710-i3.name: Ghee or oil for greasing the paper

instructions.1: Wash and dry the tomatoes and hollow them out, keeping the lid intact and attached.
instructions.2: Season each with a little salt and pepper, turn upside down and leave for ten minutes.
instructions.3: Strain the scooped-out pulp and use it in the filling.
instructions.4: Fill the tomatoes halfway and replace the lids, then wrap each in paper greased with ghee or oil depending on the filling.
instructions.5: Arrange in a pot, add some salted water and cook over low heat until done.
instructions.6: Take off the heat and let cool slightly, then carefully remove the paper, arrange on a plate and garnish with parsley.
instructions.7: Serve hot if stuffed with the raw meat filling, and cold if stuffed with dolma filling.

osool-711.title: Baked Tomatoes Stuffed with Spiced Mince

instructions.1: Prepare, hollow out, season and drain the tomatoes as before.
instructions.2: Fill with the asag and brush with ghee.
instructions.3: Arrange in a tray greased with ghee and bake in a moderate oven for 10 to 15 minutes.
instructions.4: Arrange on a plate, garnish with parsley and serve hot.
instructions.5: Tomatoes stuffed with spiced mince and rice: mix ⅛ kg asag with 3 tablespoons boiled rice, 1 tablespoon chopped parsley and a little ghee and season; fill the tomatoes, brush with ghee, arrange in a greased tray and bake in a moderate oven for 10 minutes.

osool-712-i1.name: Mixed vegetables for stuffing (black and white eggplants, peppers, tomatoes, zucchini and lettuce, grape or cabbage leaves)

osool-712-i2.name: Dolma filling (onion, rice, oil, parsley, mint and tomatoes)

osool-712-i3.name: Vegetables sliced into rounds (carrots, onions and celery)

instructions.1: Prepare each vegetable according to its kind: hollow out the eggplants, zucchini and peppers, blanch the leaves briefly in salted water, then stuff them with the filling.
instructions.2: Layer them alternately with the sliced vegetables, covering each layer with a sheet of glazed paper brushed with oil.
instructions.3: Stuff the tomatoes, wrap each one in greased paper and place them on top.
instructions.4: Add the oil and a little salted water.
instructions.5: Cover the pot and cook over low heat until done.
instructions.6: Leave to cool, then arrange neatly and attractively on a platter and garnish with parsley.

osool-501.title: Boiled Green Beans, Served Several Ways
osool-501.culturalNotes: To keep green vegetables green, boil them quickly in salted boiling water in an uncovered pot and lift them out as soon as they are done.

osool-501-i4.name: A pinch of baking soda (optional, to keep the color)

osool-501-i5.name: For serving with oil and lemon: olive oil

osool-501-i6.name: For serving with oil and lemon: lemon juice

instructions.1: Wash the beans well and remove the side strings by hand or with a knife, then slice lengthwise into thin strips or cut diagonally into oblong pieces.
instructions.2: Bring the water to a boil and add the salt and baking soda, then drop the beans into the boiling water and cook uncovered until tender (15 to 30 minutes), skimming off any scum.
instructions.3: Drain as soon as they are done.
instructions.4: With oil and lemon: let them cool; whisk the oil with the lemon, salt and pepper, dress the beans with it and serve.
instructions.5: In stock: sauté half-boiled beans in 1 tablespoon butter or ghee, then add 2 cups chicken or meat stock, an onion and a piece of celery; cover and cook over low heat until tender, then remove the onion and celery.
instructions.6: In white sauce: add half-boiled beans to 2 cups light white sauce and cook over low heat until tender; season, spoon into a deep dish and garnish with chopped parsley.
instructions.7: Green black-eyed pea pods: prepare them in all these ways with the same quantities, except that the pods are cut in half crosswise rather than sliced lengthwise.

osool-502.title: Layered Green Bean and Meat Stew (without Onion Base)

instructions.1: Prepare the beans and the meat.
instructions.2: Put all the ingredients in a pot raw, in alternating layers of beans, meat, tomato rounds and onion, sprinkling a suitable amount of seasoning between the layers.
instructions.3: Add the liquid, cover the pot and cook over low heat or in a moderate oven until tender (one to one and a half hours).
instructions.4: Layered green black-eyed pea stew: made the same way.

osool-503-i4.name: For the onion base: meat cut into small cubes

osool-503-i5.name: For the onion base: chopped onion

osool-503-i7.name: For the onion base: strained tomatoes

instructions.1: For the onion base: chop the onion finely and fry in the ghee until golden, then add the meat and stir until browned; add the strained tomatoes and seasoning and stir until the tomatoes are cooked and the ghee separates.
instructions.2: Put the meat and onion base in the bottom of a small pot (daqiya) and arrange the carrot rounds around it.
instructions.3: Sauté the beans in a little ghee, or half-boil them, or leave them raw, and add the chopped garlic.
instructions.4: Put the beans on top of the meat in the pot and press down lightly to level them.
instructions.5: Add the liquid (water or stock) with the salt and pepper dissolved in it.
instructions.6: Cook over low heat with the pot covered until done.
instructions.7: Turn out onto a plate when ready to serve.
instructions.8: Black-eyed pea pod mold: made the same way.

osool-504-i4.name: Fresh mint leaves or a small onion

instructions.1: Shell the peas and wash them well.
instructions.2: Boil in water with the salt and the mint or onion or both, leaving the pot uncovered and skimming off any scum.
instructions.3: Cook until tender, then drain.
instructions.4: Sautéed: put the well-drained peas in a pan with the butter and reheat over low heat without letting them go mushy; season with salt and pepper and serve hot.
instructions.5: In stock: drain half-boiled peas and cook them with 1 tablespoon butter or ghee, an onion and 1–1½ cups stock over low heat until tender; remove the onion and serve hot.
instructions.6: With carrots: add the hot boiled peas to hot sautéed carrots with the butter and toss everything lightly off the heat.
instructions.7: With oil and lemon: dress the cold boiled peas with the oil and lemon mixture, as for green beans.

instructions.1: Press the boiled peas through a sieve and add the butter, salt and pepper.
instructions.2: Heat gently, stirring constantly, until the purée absorbs the butter and thickens.
instructions.3: Serve hot.
instructions.4: Second method: add the butter to the sieved peas and heat gently while stirring, then add the milk gradually, stirring constantly until the mixture thickens; season.
instructions.5: Pea timbales: melt the butter and let it cool, then add the egg yolks, season and beat well; add to the sieved peas and stir, then divide among small molds greased with ghee; set the molds in a tray of water reaching halfway up their sides, cover with greased paper and bake in a moderate oven for 20 minutes; lift out, let them cool slightly, then turn out and serve.

osool-506-i6.name: For garnish: parsley, lemon slices and diced boiled meat (optional)

instructions.1: Prepare the artichokes by removing the outer leaves, peeling them and cleaning the fuzzy choke from the center; keep them in water with lemon, then boil in boiling water with salt and lemon juice until tender and drain.
instructions.2: Place the boiled artichokes in an ovenproof dish or tray greased with ghee.
instructions.3: Cover with the white sauce and sprinkle the top with fine breadcrumbs.
instructions.4: Cut the butter into very small pieces and dot them over the top.
instructions.5: Bake in a moderate oven until the top browns and serve hot.
instructions.6: Without an oven: arrange the boiled artichokes on a plate, pour the white sauce over them, garnish with parsley, lemon and meat, or any of these, and serve hot.

osool-507.title: Artichokes with Lamb in White Sauce

osool-507-i6.name: Meat cooking broth with milk
osool-507-i6.standardAmount: 2 cups broth and 1 cup milk (or 3 cups broth)

instructions.1: Cut the meat into slices and boil in a liter of water until nearly tender.
instructions.2: Make the white sauce with the ghee, flour, meat broth and milk (or broth alone) and season well with salt and pepper.
instructions.3: Add the cut-up boiled artichokes, the cut-up boiled carrots and the meat, and cook over low heat until everything is tender.
instructions.4: Adjust the seasoning, add the lemon, take off the heat and serve hot.
instructions.5: With yogurt: make the white sauce with 3 cups meat broth, add the boiled artichokes and cook until tender; whisk a large bowl of well-set yogurt, strain it and add it to the artichokes, bring to one boil, season, add the lemon juice and serve hot.

osool-508.title: Stewed Artichokes and Artichokes in Tomato Sauce

instructions.1: Make the onion base: chop the onion finely and fry in the ghee until golden, then add the meat and stir until browned, then the strained tomatoes and seasoning, stirring until the tomatoes are cooked and the ghee separates.
instructions.2: Add the liquid and bring to a boil, then add the half-boiled artichokes.
instructions.3: Cover the pot and cook over low heat until tender.
instructions.4: Artichokes in tomato sauce: half-boil 8 to 10 artichokes; make the sauce by frying a chopped onion in ghee, adding strained tomatoes until cooked, then a cup of stock; add ¼–½ kg diced meat and cook until nearly tender, then add the artichokes, cover and cook until done.
instructions.5: In tomato sauce, second method: fry the artichokes after half-boiling them, or fry them raw; lift them out, make the sauce with the remaining ghee and finish cooking as above.

instructions.1: Prepare the artichokes and cut each into 2 to 4 pieces depending on size.
instructions.2: Half-boil them, then fry lightly in the ghee and lift out.
instructions.3: Add the tomatoes to the remaining ghee and cook until done, then add the asag.
instructions.4: Arrange the artichokes neatly in a small pot, with the asag and tomatoes between the layers.
instructions.5: Pour the liquid over, cover the pot and cook over low heat until done, or bake in a moderate oven.
instructions.6: Turn out onto a fairly deep plate and serve.

osool-510-i2.name: French batter (flour, oil, warm water and whisked egg white)

instructions.1: Clean the artichokes and leave them briefly in water with lemon; cut each into quarters or halves depending on size, or leave whole.
instructions.2: Boil until two-thirds cooked as usual.
instructions.3: Coat the pieces in the French batter and deep-fry in plenty of ghee.
instructions.4: Sprinkle with a little salt and pepper, garnish with parsley and serve hot.

osool-511-i4.name: For the onion base: meat, cut up

osool-511-i5.name: For the onion base: chopped onion

osool-511-i7.name: For the onion base: strained tomatoes

instructions.1: Remove the green outer leaves, separate the remaining leaves and wash them carefully.
instructions.2: Bring the water to a boil with 1 teaspoon each of salt and cumin per liter, drop in the leaves and cook until tender; lift them out carefully into a colander.
instructions.3: Stewed cabbage: cut the cabbage into medium pieces and half-boil them; make the onion base (onion fried in ghee with the meat, then the tomatoes), add the liquid and the boiled cabbage, cover the pot and cook over low heat until tender.
instructions.4: Boiled cabbage is used on its own for stuffing, or cooked with tomatoes or with vinegar.

osool-512.title: Layered Cabbage Mold with Spiced Mince and Pine Nuts

osool-512-i2.name: Asag with pine nuts and tomatoes

instructions.1: Separate the cabbage leaves carefully so they stay whole and half-boil them; lift out and leave to drain, and pick out the white inner leaves for the mold.
instructions.2: Lay one whole leaf so it covers the bottom and sides of the pot.
instructions.3: Add a layer of asag, then another layer of leaves, and so on until everything is used (about 8 leaves).
instructions.4: Fold the edges of the leaves over to cover the top of the mold.
instructions.5: Add the seasoned liquid, cover the pot and cook over low heat or in a moderate oven until done.
instructions.6: Turn out onto a plate and serve hot.

osool-513.title: Whole Stuffed Cabbage with Spiced Mince

osool-513-i5.name: Onion and carrot, sliced into rounds

instructions.1: Remove the green outer leaves and half-boil the cabbage whole.
instructions.2: Carefully remove the middle leaves from the top end using a sharp knife.
instructions.3: Fill the hollow with the asag and tie the cabbage in cheesecloth to keep its shape.
instructions.4: Peel the onion and carrot, slice into rounds and place them in the bottom of the pot, with the cabbage on top.
instructions.5: Add the water to the strained tomatoes, season with salt and pepper and pour into the pot.
instructions.6: Cover the pot and cook over low heat or in a moderate oven until done.
instructions.7: Carefully untie the cheesecloth, place the cabbage on a plate and strain the sauce around it.

osool-514.title: Buttered Brussels Sprouts
osool-514.culturalNotes: Brussels sprouts are a kind of cabbage about the size of a large lemon.

instructions.1: Remove any wilted or dry outer leaves.
instructions.2: Wash and soak in salted water for a quarter of an hour to remove anything clinging to them, then rinse well.
instructions.3: Boil in salted boiling water until tender (10 to 20 minutes), then drain.
instructions.4: Add a piece of butter while hot and serve at once.
instructions.5: In white sauce: cover the boiled sprouts with white sauce and serve hot.

osool-515-i2.name: Salt
osool-515-i2.standardAmount: ½ teaspoon per liter of water

osool-515-i3.name: Cumin
osool-515-i3.standardAmount: ½ teaspoon per liter of water

osool-515-i4.name: French dressing (oil and vinegar or lemon, salt and pepper)

instructions.1: Bring the water to a boil with the salt and cumin, and put in the cauliflower flower-side down so the scum does not collect on it.
instructions.2: Leave the pot uncovered until tender (15 to 30 minutes), then drain.
instructions.3: Cut up, dress with the French dressing, arrange neatly on the plate and garnish with chopped parsley.

osool-516-i3.name: Onion base with minced meat (or asag with tomatoes)

instructions.1: Cut the cauliflower into medium pieces, pat dry, half-fry in the ghee and lift out.
instructions.2: Make the onion base with minced meat in the remaining ghee.
instructions.3: Layer the cauliflower and minced meat alternately in a pot, mold or tagine, starting with meat; season the liquid with salt and pepper and pour it over.
instructions.4: Cover and cook over low heat or in a moderate oven until done.
instructions.5: Serve ladled into a deep dish, turned out of the mold, or in the tagine wrapped with a paper frill.
instructions.6: Stewed cauliflower: make the onion base, add the half-boiled cauliflower cut into medium pieces, cover and cook over low heat until tender.
instructions.7: Cauliflower moussaka with egg: made as above, except that the boiled cauliflower is dipped in 2 beaten eggs and fried before use.

osool-517-i8.name: Vinegar-garlic sauce or tomato sauce, for serving

instructions.1: Break the eggs, beat them lightly and season with salt and pepper.
instructions.2: Cut the boiled cauliflower into even pieces and pat dry.
instructions.3: Dust the pieces lightly with flour, then dip them in the egg.
instructions.4: Fry in a little ghee and lift onto paper to absorb the ghee.
instructions.5: Arrange the pieces neatly on a plate and garnish with parsley, or serve with a vinegar-garlic sauce.
instructions.6: Simple fried cauliflower: fry the dried boiled cauliflower uncoated in very hot ghee or oil, lift onto paper and serve with vinegar-garlic sauce.
instructions.7: In egg and breadcrumbs: after dipping the pieces in egg, coat them in fine white breadcrumbs and deep- or shallow-fry in ghee.
instructions.8: In batter: dust two-thirds-boiled cauliflower pieces lightly with seasoned flour, dip in French batter and deep-fry in plenty of ghee; serve hot with tomato sauce.

osool-518-i4.name: French dressing (oil, vinegar, salt and pepper) or butter

instructions.1: Wash, peel and slice the zucchini, or leave them whole if small.
instructions.2: Boil in the salted boiling water over fairly low heat until tender, then drain.
instructions.3: With oil and lemon: arrange the drained zucchini on a plate, pour some French dressing over and leave for at least a quarter of an hour; garnish with parsley.
instructions.4: Sautéed: put the drained boiled zucchini in a pan with 1 tablespoon butter and reheat, shaking the pan so they do not break up; place on a warm plate and garnish with parsley.
instructions.5: In stock: sauté in butter, then cook in a little meat or chicken stock with an onion, using less liquid.

instructions.1: Peel and cut up the zucchini and sauté in 1 tablespoon butter for 10 minutes, making sure the pieces hold together and do not change color.
instructions.2: Add a very little water or stock, cover the pot and cook over low heat until tender.
instructions.3: Lift the pieces out carefully into an ovenproof dish or tray and cover with the white sauce (the liquid left from cooking the zucchini can be added to the milk for the sauce); sprinkle with the cheese if using.
instructions.4: Sprinkle the top with the breadcrumbs, and dot with the remaining ½ tablespoon butter cut into very small pieces.
instructions.5: Bake in a low oven until the top browns.

instructions.1: Peel the zucchini and cut into rounds or medium pieces; cut up the meat, and slice the onion and tomatoes into rounds.
instructions.2: Put the zucchini, meat, tomato and onion rounds and celery raw into a pot in alternating layers, sprinkling seasoning between the layers.
instructions.3: Add a small amount of liquid (less than usual, since zucchini are watery) and cover the pot.
instructions.4: Cook over low heat or in a moderate oven until the meat and zucchini are tender.
instructions.5: Stewed with an onion base: chop the onion and fry in the ghee, then add the meat, then the strained tomatoes until cooked; add the liquid and the zucchini, cover and cook until tender, adding a few chickpeas if you like.
instructions.6: Zucchini moussaka: peel the zucchini, slice and salt them, then fry lightly in ghee; make the onion base with minced meat, then layer the zucchini and meat alternately in a pot or tagine, pour over the seasoned liquid and cook over low heat or in a moderate oven until done.

osool-521.title: Syrian-Style Stuffed Zucchini in Yogurt Sauce

instructions.1: Wash the zucchini and hollow them out without peeling, then rinse with salted water.
instructions.2: Stuff with the asag and sauté in half the ghee.
instructions.3: Arrange in the pot, add a little water and cook over low heat, adding a little water from time to time, until tender.
instructions.4: Put the yogurt in a bowl and whisk well; mix the flour well with a little water and add it to the whisked yogurt; beat the egg white lightly and add it to the yogurt; thin the mixture with a little water, then strain through a wire strainer.
instructions.5: Heat the yogurt gently, stirring well, for 5 minutes.
instructions.6: Pour it into the pot with the zucchini and heat gently for 5 to 10 minutes.
instructions.7: Chop the garlic finely and fry it in the remaining ghee, then add it to the zucchini, cover the pot and take it off the heat.
instructions.8: Ladle the zucchini onto a plate, pour the sauce over and serve hot.

osool-522-i6.name: Vinegar-garlic sauce or yogurt salad, for serving

instructions.1: Cut the zucchini into medium-thick slices and soak in salted water.
instructions.2: Pat dry, and coat lightly in flour if you like.
instructions.3: Fry in very hot oil.
instructions.4: Arrange on a plate, garnish with parsley and serve with the vinegar-garlic sauce or yogurt sauce.

osool-523.title: Carrots: Boiled, Sautéed or in White Sauce

instructions.1: Wash the carrots and leave whole, or wash, scrape and cut into rounds, sticks or cubes as needed.
instructions.2: Boil in salted water with the pot covered for 20 to 30 minutes; drain, and peel any unpeeled carrots while hot.
instructions.3: Sautéed: put half-boiled carrots in a pan with a cup of water, salt, pepper and the butter and cook over low heat until tender; serve as is, or drain off the liquid and garnish with parsley.
instructions.4: In white sauce: boil the cut carrots, drain and arrange on the plate; cover with the white sauce, garnish with parsley and serve hot.

instructions.1: Prepare the eggplant and cut it into thick rounds or fairly long pieces, and season with salt.
instructions.2: Without an onion base: put the eggplant, meat and tomato and onion rounds raw into a pot in alternating layers with the liquid and seasoning, and cook over low heat or in the oven until tender.
instructions.3: With an onion base: chop the onion and fry in the ghee until golden, then add the meat until browned, then the strained tomatoes and seasoning until the ghee separates; add the liquid and eggplant, cover the pot and cook over low heat until tender.

osool-525-i6.name: Parsley and tomato rounds, for garnish

instructions.1: Cut the eggplant into fairly thin round slices.
instructions.2: Season with salt and weigh down to press out the liquid, then pat very dry.
instructions.3: Coat lightly in flour, then in egg and breadcrumbs, and fry.
instructions.4: Arrange neatly on a plate and garnish with parsley and tomato rounds.

osool-526.title: Baked Baladi Eggplant Stuffed with Spiced Mince

instructions.1: Peel the eggplants, or leave them unpeeled, or peel them in alternating strips, keeping the stem on in every case.
instructions.2: Slit them along the side, scoop out a little of the flesh and leave them in salted water for a quarter of an hour.
instructions.3: Lift out, pat dry, fry in the ghee and lift out, then stuff with the asag mixed with the pine nuts and parsley.
instructions.4: Arrange side by side in a tray greased with ghee.
instructions.5: Add the water to the tomato juice, season with salt and pepper and pour over the eggplants.
instructions.6: Cover with paper greased with ghee and bake in a moderate oven until done.

osool-527.title: Eggplant Bake with White Sauce and Spiced Mince

instructions.1: Prepare the eggplant as before, season it and drain off its liquid, then sauté in ghee and lift out.
instructions.2: Make the white sauce and let it cool somewhat, then add the lightly beaten eggs and stir together.
instructions.3: Layer the eggplant, sauce and asag with pine nuts alternately, making sure the last layer is sauce.
instructions.4: Sprinkle the top with the breadcrumbs, cut the butter into very small pieces and dot them evenly over the top.
instructions.5: Bake in a moderate oven until the top browns.

osool-528.title: Roasted Eggplant with Oil, Lemon and Garlic
osool-528.culturalNotes: Roasted eggplant is also used in tahini dip and baba ghanoush.

osool-528-i4.name: French dressing (oil and vinegar or lemon, salt and pepper)

instructions.1: Wash and dry the eggplants, leave them whole and place in a tray.
instructions.2: Roast in a moderate oven until tender.
instructions.3: Peel the roasted eggplants and cut them neatly into long strips.
instructions.4: Crush the garlic finely with some salt and add the chili; season the eggplant with this mixture and arrange on the plate.
instructions.5: Pour the French dressing over and garnish with chopped parsley.

instructions.1: Peel the small potatoes and boil them, or boil them in their skins and then peel.
instructions.2: Heat the butter and toss the potatoes in it; season with salt and pepper and sprinkle with the chopped parsley.
instructions.3: Second method: peel the potatoes and cut into 1 × 1 cm cubes; boil in salted water until nearly done and drain, then sauté in the butter and sprinkle with parsley, salt and pepper.
instructions.4: Third method: cut cold boiled potatoes into even rounds; heat a little ghee until very hot and add the rounds; when the undersides are browned, turn them to brown the other side, then lift onto paper to absorb the ghee and serve hot.

instructions.1: Peel the potatoes and onions and cut into fairly thick rounds; rub the onions with salt and pepper.
instructions.2: Cut the meat into even pieces.
instructions.3: Put the meat, onions and potatoes in a pot in alternating layers.
instructions.4: Pour in the liquid seasoned with salt and pepper and cover the pot.
instructions.5: Cook over low heat until tender, one to one and a half hours.
instructions.6: Serve with the meat in the center and the potatoes around it, hot.
instructions.7: Potato tagine: put the same ingredients in a tagine in alternating layers, finishing with potatoes on top; cover and bake in a moderate oven until done (one to one and a half hours), then uncover so the top browns; wrap the tagine with a paper frill and serve hot.

osool-531.title: Baked Potatoes with Poultry or Meat

osool-531-i3.name: A bird (goose, chicken or small duck) or leg meat

instructions.1: Peel the potatoes, cut into fairly thick rounds and keep in salted water until needed.
instructions.2: Peel the onions, slice into thin rings and rub well with salt and pepper.
instructions.3: Strain half the tomatoes; peel the other half and slice into rounds.
instructions.4: Wash the bird or meat and leave whole or cut into fairly large pieces; season with salt and pepper and push half garlic cloves into it if using.
instructions.5: Layer the potatoes and onions alternately in a baking tray or tagine with the meat in the middle and the tomato rounds on top.
